## Structs[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structs)

## Functions[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#functions)

- [const_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.const_modules.html)- modules
- [debug_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.debug_assert_valid.html)- assert_ - valid
- Assert in debug mode. This is noop in release build.
- [inline_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.inline_globals.html)- globals
- Create a global inlining pass, which replaces expressions with the specified value.
- [json_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.json_parse.html)- parse
- Transform to optimize performance of literals.

## Type Aliases[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#types)

- [Global](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/type.GlobalExprMap.html)- Expr - Map
- The key will be compared using [EqIgnoreSpan::eq_ignore_span], and matched expressions will be replaced with the value.

- `pub use self::simplify::`- [simplifier](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/simplify/fn.simplifier.html);

## Modules[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#modules)

- [simplify](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/simplify/index.html)
- Ported from closure compiler.

## Structs[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structs)

## Functions[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#functions)

- [const_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.const_modules.html)- modules
- [debug_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.debug_assert_valid.html)- assert_ - valid
- Assert in debug mode. This is noop in release build.
- [inline_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.inline_globals.html)- globals
- Create a global inlining pass, which replaces expressions with the specified value.
- [json_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.json_parse.html)- parse
- Transform to optimize performance of literals.

## Type Aliases[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#types)

- [Global](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/type.GlobalExprMap.html)- Expr - Map
- The key will be compared using [EqIgnoreSpan::eq_ignore_span], and matched expressions will be replaced with the value.

- Performs simplify-expr, inlining, remove-dead-branch and dce until nothing changes.

# json_parse in swc_ecma_transforms_optimization - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_transforms_optimization/fn.json_parse.html

`pub fn json_parse(min_cost: `[usize](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.usize.html)) -> impl Pass## Expand description

Transform to optimize performance of literals.

This transform converts pure object literals like

`{a: 1, b: 2}`to

`JSON.parse('{"a":1, "b"}')`[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#conditions)Conditions

If any of the conditions below is matched, pure object literal is converter
to `JSON.parse`

- Object literal is deeply nested (threshold: )

See https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/409

# inlining in swc_ecma_transforms_optimization::simplify::inlining - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_transforms_optimization/simplify/inlining/fn.inlining.html

```
pub fn inlining(
    _:
```
[Config](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.Config.html),
) -> impl 'static + Repeated + CompilerPass + Pass + VisitMut## Expand description

Note: this pass assumes that resolver is invoked before the pass.

As swc focuses on reducing gzipped file size, all strings are inlined.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#todos)TODOs

- Handling of `void 0`
- Properly handle binary expressions.
- Track variables access by a function

Currently all functions are treated as a black box, and all the pass gives up inlining variables across a function call or a constructor call.

---

[22](#22)pub fn const_modules(
[23](#23)    cm: Lrc<SourceMap>,
[24](#24)    globals: FxHashMap<Atom, FxHashMap<Atom, BytesStr>>,
[25](#25)) -> impl Pass {
[26](#26)    visit_mut_pass(ConstModules {
[27](#27)        globals: globals
[28](#28)            .into_iter()
[29](#29)            .map(|(src, map)| {
[30](#30)                let map = map
[31](#31)                    .into_iter()
[32](#32)                    .map(|(key, value)| {
[33](#33)                        let value = parse_option(&cm, &key, value);
[34](#34)
[35](#35)                        (key.into(), value)
[36](#36)                    })
[37](#37)                    .collect();
[38](#38)
[39](#39)                (src.into(), map)
[40](#40)            })
[41](#41)            .collect(),
[42](#42)        scope: Default::default(),
[43](#43)    })

[45](#45)
[46](#46)fn parse_option(cm: &SourceMap, name: &str, src: BytesStr) -> Arc<Expr> {
[47](#47)    static CACHE: Lazy<DashMap<BytesStr, Arc<Expr>, FxBuildHasher>> = Lazy::new(DashMap::default);
[48](#48)
[49](#49)    let fm = cm.new_source_file(
[50](#50)        FileName::Internal(format!("<const-module-{name}.js>")).into(),
[51](#51)        src,
[52](#52)    );
[53](#53)    if let Some(expr) = CACHE.get(&fm.src) {
[54](#54)        return expr.clone();
[55](#55)    }
[56](#56)
[57](#57)    let expr = parse_file_as_expr(
[58](#58)        &fm,
[59](#59)        Default::default(),
[60](#60)        Default::default(),
[61](#61)        None,
[62](#62)        &mut Vec::new(),
[63](#63)    )
[64](#64)    .map_err(|e| {
[65](#65)        if HANDLER.is_set() {
[66](#66)            HANDLER.with(|h| e.into_diagnostic(h).emit())
[67](#67)        }
[68](#68)    })
[69](#69)    .map(drop_span)
[70](#70)    .unwrap_or_else(|()| {
[71](#71)        panic!(
[72](#72)            "failed to parse jsx option {}: '{}' is not an expression",
[73](#73)            name, fm.src,
[74](#74)        )
[75](#75)    });
[76](#76)
[77](#77)    let expr = Arc::new(*expr);
[78](#78)
[79](#79)    CACHE.insert(fm.src.clone(), expr.clone());
[80](#80)
[81](#81)    expr
[82](#82)}

[95](#95)impl VisitMut for ConstModules {
[96](#96)    noop_visit_mut_type!(fail);
[97](#97)
[98](#98)    fn visit_mut_module_items(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ModuleItem>) {
[99](#99)        *n = n.take().move_flat_map(|item| match item {
[100](#100)            ModuleItem::ModuleDecl(ModuleDecl::Import(import)) => {
[101](#101)                let entry = self.globals.get(&import.src.value);
[102](#102)                if let Some(entry) = entry {
[103](#103)                    for s in &import.specifiers {
[104](#104)                        match *s {
[105](#105)                            ImportSpecifier::Named(ref s) => {
[106](#106)                                let imported = s
[107](#107)                                    .imported
[108](#108)                                    .as_ref()
[109](#109)                                    .map(|m| match m {
[110](#110)                                        ModuleExportName::Ident(id) => id.sym.clone().into(),
[111](#111)                                        ModuleExportName::Str(s) => s.value.clone(),
[112](#112)                                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[113](#113)                                        _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[114](#114)                                    })
[115](#115)                                    .unwrap_or_else(|| s.local.sym.clone().into());
[116](#116)                                let value = entry.get(&imported).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
[117](#117)                                    panic!(
[118](#118)                                        "The requested const_module `{:?}` does not provide an \
[119](#119)                                         export named `{:?}`",
[120](#120)                                        import.src.value, imported
[121](#121)                                    )
[122](#122)                                });
[123](#123)                                self.scope.imported.insert(imported.clone(), value);
[124](#124)                            }
[125](#125)                            ImportSpecifier::Namespace(ref s) => {
[126](#126)                                self.scope.namespace.insert(s.local.to_id());
[127](#127)                            }
[128](#128)                            ImportSpecifier::Default(ref s) => {
[129](#129)                                let imported: Wtf8Atom = s.local.sym.clone().into();
[130](#130)                                let default_import_key: Wtf8Atom = atom!("default").into();
[131](#131)                                let value =
[132](#132)                                    entry.get(&default_import_key).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
[133](#133)                                        panic!(
[134](#134)                                            "The requested const_module `{:?}` does not provide \
[135](#135)                                             default export",
[136](#136)                                            import.src.value
[137](#137)                                        )
[138](#138)                                    });
[139](#139)                                self.scope.imported.insert(imported, value);
[140](#140)                            }
[141](#141)                            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[142](#142)                            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[143](#143)                        };
[144](#144)                    }
[145](#145)
[146](#146)                    None
[147](#147)                } else {
[148](#148)                    Some(import.into())
[149](#149)                }
[150](#150)            }
[151](#151)            _ => Some(item),
[152](#152)        });
[153](#153)
[154](#154)        if self.scope.imported.is_empty() && self.scope.namespace.is_empty() {
[155](#155)            return;
[156](#156)        }
[157](#157)
[158](#158)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[159](#159)    }
[160](#160)
[161](#161)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Expr) {
[162](#162)        match n {
[163](#163)            Expr::Ident(ref id @ Ident { ref sym, .. }) => {
[164](#164)                let sym_wtf8: Wtf8Atom = sym.clone().into();
[165](#165)                if let Some(value) = self.scope.imported.get(&sym_wtf8) {
[166](#166)                    *n = (**value).clone();
[167](#167)                    return;
[168](#168)                }
[169](#169)
[170](#170)                if self.scope.namespace.contains(&id.to_id()) {
[171](#171)                    panic!(
[172](#172)                        "The const_module namespace `{sym}` cannot be used without member accessor"
[173](#173)                    )
[174](#174)                }
[175](#175)            }
[176](#176)            Expr::Member(MemberExpr { obj, prop, .. }) if obj.is_ident() => {
[177](#177)                if let Some(module_name) = obj
[178](#178)                    .as_ident()
[179](#179)                    .filter(|member_obj| self.scope.namespace.contains(&member_obj.to_id()))
[180](#180)                    .map(|member_obj| &member_obj.sym)
[181](#181)                {
[182](#182)                    let imported_name: Wtf8Atom = match prop {
[183](#183)                        MemberProp::Ident(ref id) => id.sym.clone().into(),
[184](#184)                        MemberProp::Computed(ref p) => match &*p.expr {
[185](#185)                            Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(s)) => s.value.clone(),
[186](#186)                            _ => return,
[187](#187)                        },
[188](#188)                        MemberProp::PrivateName(..) => return,
[189](#189)                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[190](#190)                        _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[191](#191)                    };
[192](#192)
[193](#193)                    let module_name_wtf8: Wtf8Atom = module_name.clone().into();
[194](#194)                    let value = self
[195](#195)                        .globals
[196](#196)                        .get(&module_name_wtf8)
[197](#197)                        .and_then(|entry| entry.get(&imported_name))
[198](#198)                        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
[199](#199)                            panic!(
[200](#200)                                "The requested const_module `{module_name}` does not provide an \
[201](#201)                                 export named `{imported_name:?}`"
[202](#202)                            )
[203](#203)                        });
[204](#204)
[205](#205)                    *n = (**value).clone();
[206](#206)                } else {
[207](#207)                    n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[208](#208)                }
[209](#209)            }
[210](#210)            _ => {
[211](#211)                n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[212](#212)            }
[213](#213)        };
[214](#214)    }
[215](#215)
[216](#216)    fn visit_mut_prop(&mut self, n: &mut Prop) {
[217](#217)        match n {
[218](#218)            Prop::Shorthand(id) => {
[219](#219)                let sym_wtf8: Wtf8Atom = id.sym.clone().into();
[220](#220)                if let Some(value) = self.scope.imported.get(&sym_wtf8) {
[221](#221)                    *n = Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[222](#222)                        key: id.take().into(),
[223](#223)                        value: Box::new((**value).clone()),
[224](#224)                    });
[225](#225)                    return;
[226](#226)                }
[227](#227)
[228](#228)                if self.scope.namespace.contains(&id.to_id()) {
[229](#229)                    panic!(
[230](#230)                        "The const_module namespace `{}` cannot be used without member accessor",
[231](#231)                        id.sym
[232](#232)                    )
[233](#233)                }
[234](#234)            }
[235](#235)            _ => n.visit_mut_children_with(self),
[236](#236)        }
[237](#237)    }
[238](#238)}

[9](#9)pub type GlobalExprMap = Lrc<FxHashMap<NodeIgnoringSpan<'static, Expr>, Expr>>;
[12](#12)
[13](#13)pub fn inline_globals(
[20](#20)    envs: Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Expr>>,
[21](#21)    globals: Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Expr>>,
[22](#22)    global_exprs: GlobalExprMap,

[40](#40)#[derive(Clone)]
[41](#41)struct InlineGlobals {
[42](#42)    envs: Lrc<FxHashMap<Wtf8Atom, Expr>>,
[43](#43)    globals: Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Expr>>,
[44](#44)    global_exprs: Lrc<FxHashMap<NodeIgnoringSpan<'static, Expr>, Expr>>,
[45](#45)
[46](#46)    typeofs: Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Atom>>,
[47](#47)

[51](#51)impl Parallel for InlineGlobals {
[52](#52)    fn create(&self) -> Self {
[53](#53)        self.clone()
[54](#54)    }
[55](#55)
[56](#56)    fn merge(&mut self, _: Self) {}

[59](#59)impl VisitMut for InlineGlobals {
[60](#60)    noop_visit_mut_type!(fail);
[61](#61)
[62](#62)    fn visit_mut_class_members(&mut self, members: &mut Vec<ClassMember>) {
[63](#63)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count(), members);
[64](#64)    }
[65](#65)
[66](#66)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, expr: &mut Expr) {
[67](#67)        if let Expr::Ident(id) = expr {
[68](#68)            if self.bindings.contains(&id.to_id()) {
[69](#69)                return;
[70](#70)            }
[71](#71)        }
[72](#72)
[73](#73)        if let Some(value) =
[74](#74)            Ident::within_ignored_ctxt(|| self.global_exprs.get(&NodeIgnoringSpan::borrowed(expr)))
[75](#75)        {
[76](#76)            *expr = value.clone();
[77](#77)            expr.visit_mut_with(self);
[78](#78)            return;
[79](#79)        }
[80](#80)
[81](#81)        expr.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[82](#82)
[83](#83)        match expr {
[84](#84)            Expr::Ident(Ident { ref sym, .. }) => {
[85](#85)                if let Some(value) = self.globals.get(sym) {
[87](#87)                    let mut value = value.clone();
[88](#88)                    value.visit_mut_with(self);
[89](#89)                    *expr = value;
[90](#90)                }
[91](#91)            }
[92](#92)
[93](#93)            Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[94](#94)                span,
[95](#95)                op: op!("typeof"),
[96](#96)                arg,
[97](#97)                ..
[98](#98)            }) => {
[99](#99)                if let Expr::Ident(ident @ Ident { ref sym, .. }) = &**arg {
[100](#100)                    if self.bindings.contains(&ident.to_id()) {
[102](#102)                        return;
[103](#103)                    }
[104](#104)
[105](#105)                    if let Some(value) = self.typeofs.get(sym).cloned() {
[107](#107)                        *expr = Lit::Str(Str {
[108](#108)                            span: *span,
[109](#109)                            raw: None,
[110](#110)                            value: value.into(),
[111](#111)                        })
[112](#112)                        .into();
[113](#113)                    }
[114](#114)                }
[115](#115)            }
[116](#116)
[117](#117)            Expr::Member(MemberExpr { obj, prop, .. }) => match &**obj {
[118](#118)                Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[119](#119)                    obj: first_obj,
[120](#120)                    prop: inner_prop,
[121](#121)                    ..
[122](#122)                }) if inner_prop.is_ident_with("env") => {
[123](#123)                    if first_obj.is_ident_ref_to("process") {
[124](#124)                        match prop {
[125](#125)                            MemberProp::Computed(ComputedPropName { expr: c, .. }) => {
[126](#126)                                if let Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str { value: sym, .. })) = &**c {
[127](#127)                                    if let Some(env) = self.envs.get(sym) {
[128](#128)                                        *expr = env.clone();
[129](#129)                                    }
[130](#130)                                }
[131](#131)                            }
[132](#132)
[133](#133)                            MemberProp::Ident(IdentName { sym, .. }) => {
[134](#134)                                let sym_wtf8: Wtf8Atom = sym.clone().into();
[135](#135)                                if let Some(env) = self.envs.get(&sym_wtf8) {
[136](#136)                                    *expr = env.clone();
[137](#137)                                }
[138](#138)                            }
[139](#139)                            _ => {}
[140](#140)                        }
[141](#141)                    }
[142](#142)                }
[143](#143)                _ => (),
[144](#144)            },
[145](#145)            _ => {}
[146](#146)        }
[147](#147)    }
[148](#148)
[149](#149)    fn visit_mut_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ExprOrSpread>) {
[150](#150)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count(), n);
[151](#151)    }
[152](#152)
[153](#153)    fn visit_mut_exprs(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Box<Expr>>) {
[154](#154)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count(), n);
[155](#155)    }
[156](#156)
[157](#157)    fn visit_mut_module(&mut self, module: &mut Module) {
[158](#158)        self.bindings = Lrc::new(collect_decls(&*module));
[159](#159)
[160](#160)        module.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[161](#161)    }
[162](#162)
[163](#163)    fn visit_mut_opt_vec_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Option<ExprOrSpread>>) {
[164](#164)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count(), n);
[165](#165)    }
[166](#166)
[167](#167)    fn visit_mut_prop(&mut self, p: &mut Prop) {
[168](#168)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[169](#169)
[170](#170)        if let Prop::Shorthand(i) = p {
[171](#171)            if self.bindings.contains(&i.to_id()) {
[173](#173)                return;
[174](#174)            }
[175](#175)
[176](#176)            if let Some(mut value) = self.globals.get(&i.sym).cloned().map(Box::new) {
[178](#178)                value.visit_mut_with(self);
[179](#179)                *p = Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[180](#180)                    key: PropName::Ident(i.clone().into()),
[181](#181)                    value,
[182](#182)                });
[183](#183)            }
[184](#184)        }
[185](#185)    }
[186](#186)
[187](#187)    fn visit_mut_prop_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<PropOrSpread>) {
[188](#188)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count(), n);
[189](#189)    }
[190](#190)
[191](#191)    fn visit_mut_script(&mut self, script: &mut Script) {
[192](#192)        self.bindings = Lrc::new(collect_decls(&*script));
[193](#193)
[194](#194)        script.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[195](#195)    }

[198](#198)#[cfg(test)]
[199](#199)mod tests {
[200](#200)    use swc_common::Mark;
[201](#201)    use swc_ecma_transforms_testing::{test, Tester};
[202](#202)    use swc_ecma_transforms_typescript::typescript;
[203](#203)    use swc_ecma_utils::{DropSpan, StmtOrModuleItem};
[204](#204)
[205](#205)    use super::*;
[206](#206)
[207](#207)    fn mk_map(
[208](#208)        tester: &mut Tester<'_>,
[209](#209)        values: &[(&str, &str)],
[210](#210)        is_env: bool,
[211](#211)    ) -> FxHashMap<Atom, Expr> {
[212](#212)        let mut m = FxHashMap::default();
[213](#213)
[214](#214)        for (k, v) in values {
[215](#215)            let v = if is_env {
[216](#216)                format!("'{v}'")
[217](#217)            } else {
[218](#218)                (*v).into()
[219](#219)            };
[220](#220)
[221](#221)            let v = tester
[222](#222)                .apply_transform(
[223](#223)                    visit_mut_pass(DropSpan),
[224](#224)                    "global.js",
[225](#225)                    ::swc_ecma_parser::Syntax::default(),
[226](#226)                    None,
[227](#227)                    &v,
[228](#228)                )
[229](#229)                .unwrap();
[230](#230)
[231](#231)            let v = match v {
[232](#232)                Program::Module(mut m) => m.body.pop().and_then(|x| x.into_stmt().ok()),
[233](#233)                Program::Script(mut s) => s.body.pop(),
[234](#234)            };
[235](#235)            assert!(v.is_some());
[236](#236)            let v = match v.unwrap() {
[237](#237)                Stmt::Expr(ExprStmt { expr, .. }) => *expr,
[238](#238)                _ => unreachable!(),
[239](#239)            };
[240](#240)
[241](#241)            m.insert((*k).into(), v);
[242](#242)        }
[243](#243)
[244](#244)        m
[245](#245)    }
[246](#246)
[247](#247)    fn envs(tester: &mut Tester<'_>, values: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Expr>> {
[248](#248)        Lrc::new(mk_map(tester, values, true))
[249](#249)    }
[250](#250)
[251](#251)    fn globals(tester: &mut Tester<'_>, values: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Lrc<FxHashMap<Atom, Expr>> {
[252](#252)        Lrc::new(mk_map(tester, values, false))
[253](#253)    }

[9](#9)pub fn json_parse(min_cost: usize) -> impl Pass {
[32](#32)    visit_mut_pass(JsonParse { min_cost })
[33](#33)}

[36](#36)    pub min_cost: usize,
[37](#37)}

[39](#39)impl Parallel for JsonParse {

[41](#41)        JsonParse {
[42](#42)            min_cost: self.min_cost,
[43](#43)        }
[44](#44)    }

[50](#50)    fn default() -> Self {
[51](#51)        JsonParse { min_cost: 1024 }
[52](#52)    }

[54](#54)
[55](#55)impl VisitMut for JsonParse {
[56](#56)    noop_visit_mut_type!(fail);
[57](#57)
[58](#58)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, expr: &mut Expr) {
[60](#60)        if self.min_cost == usize::MAX {
[61](#61)            return;
[62](#62)        }
[63](#63)
[64](#64)        let e = match expr {
[65](#65)            Expr::Array(..) | Expr::Object(..) => {
[66](#66)                let (is_lit, cost) = calc_literal_cost(&*expr, false);
[67](#67)                if is_lit && cost >= self.min_cost {
[68](#68)                    let value =
[69](#69)                        serde_json::to_string(&jsonify(expr.take())).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
[70](#70)                            unreachable!("failed to serialize serde_json::Value as json: {}", err)
[71](#71)                        });
[72](#72)
[73](#73)                    *expr = CallExpr {
[74](#74)                        span: expr.span(),
[75](#75)                        callee: member_expr!(Default::default(), DUMMY_SP, JSON.parse).as_callee(),
[76](#76)                        args: vec![Lit::Str(Str {
[77](#77)                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[78](#78)                            raw: None,
[79](#79)                            value: value.into(),
[80](#80)                        })
[81](#81)                        .as_arg()],
[82](#82)                        ..Default::default()
[83](#83)                    }
[84](#84)                    .into();
[85](#85)                    return;
[86](#86)                }
[87](#87)
[88](#88)                expr
[89](#89)            }
[90](#90)            _ => expr,
[91](#91)        };
[92](#92)
[93](#93)        e.visit_mut_children_with(self)
[94](#94)    }
[95](#95)}
[96](#96)
[97](#97)fn wtf8_to_json_string(value: &Wtf8Atom) -> String {
[99](#99)    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {
[100](#100)        return s.to_string();
[102](#102)    }
[103](#103)
[104](#104)    let mut result = String::with_capacity(value.len());
[106](#106)    for cp in value.as_wtf8().code_points() {
[107](#107)        if let Some(ch) = cp.to_char() {
[108](#108)            result.push(ch);
[110](#110)        } else {
[111](#111)            use std::fmt::Write;
[113](#113)            write!(&mut result, "\\u{:04X}", cp.to_u32()).unwrap();
[114](#114)        }
[115](#115)    }
[116](#116)    result
[117](#117)}
[118](#118)
[119](#119)fn jsonify(e: Expr) -> Value {
[120](#120)    match e {
[121](#121)        Expr::Object(obj) => Value::Object(
[122](#122)            obj.props
[123](#123)                .into_iter()
[124](#124)                .map(|v| match v {
[125](#125)                    PropOrSpread::Prop(p) if p.is_key_value() => p.key_value().unwrap(),
[126](#126)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[127](#127)                })
[128](#128)                .map(|p: KeyValueProp| {
[129](#129)                    let value = jsonify(*p.value);
[130](#130)                    let key = match p.key {
[131](#131)                        PropName::Str(s) => wtf8_to_json_string(&s.value),
[132](#132)                        PropName::Ident(id) => id.sym.to_string(),
[133](#133)                        PropName::Num(n) => format!("{}", n.value),
[134](#134)                        _ => unreachable!(),
[135](#135)                    };
[136](#136)                    (key, value)
[137](#137)                })
[138](#138)                .collect(),
[139](#139)        ),
[140](#140)        Expr::Array(arr) => Value::Array(
[141](#141)            arr.elems
[142](#142)                .into_iter()
[143](#143)                .map(|v| jsonify(*v.unwrap().expr))
[144](#144)                .collect(),
[145](#145)        ),
[146](#146)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str { value, .. })) => Value::String(wtf8_to_json_string(&value)),
[147](#147)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value, .. })) => {
[148](#148)            if value.fract() == 0.0 {
[149](#149)                Value::Number((value as i64).into())
[150](#150)            } else {
[151](#151)                match serde_json::Number::from_f64(value) {
[152](#152)                    Some(n) => Value::Number(n),
[153](#153)                    None => Value::Number((value as i64).into()),
[154](#154)                }
[155](#155)            }
[156](#156)        }
[157](#157)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => Value::Null,
[158](#158)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(v)) => Value::Bool(v.value),
[159](#159)        Expr::Tpl(Tpl { quasis, .. }) => Value::String(match quasis.first() {
[160](#160)            Some(TplElement {
[161](#161)                cooked: Some(value),
[162](#162)                ..
[163](#163)            }) => wtf8_to_json_string(value),
[164](#164)            _ => String::new(),
[165](#165)        }),
[166](#166)        _ => unreachable!("jsonify: Expr {:?} cannot be converted to json", e),
[167](#167)    }
[168](#168)}

[115](#115)impl Data {
[116](#116)    fn drop_usage(&mut self, id: &Id) {
[117](#117)        if let Some(e) = self.used_names.get_mut(id) {
[118](#118)            e.usage = e.usage.saturating_sub(1);
[122](#122)
[123](#123)            if e.usage == 0 && e.assign == 0 {
[124](#124)                if let Some(n) = self.get_node(id) {
[125](#125)                    self.graph.remove_node(n);
[126](#126)                }
[127](#127)            }
[128](#128)        } else if let Some(n) = self.get_node(id) {
[129](#129)            self.graph.remove_node(n);
[130](#130)        }
[131](#131)    }
[132](#132)
[133](#133)    fn drop_assign(&mut self, id: &Id) {
[134](#134)        if let Some(e) = self.used_names.get_mut(id) {
[135](#135)            e.assign = e.assign.saturating_sub(1);
[139](#139)
[140](#140)            if e.usage == 0 && e.assign == 0 {
[141](#141)                if let Some(n) = self.get_node(id) {
[142](#142)                    self.graph.remove_node(n);
[143](#143)                }
[144](#144)            }
[145](#145)        } else if let Some(n) = self.get_node(id) {
[146](#146)            self.graph.remove_node(n);
[147](#147)        }
[148](#148)    }
[149](#149)
[150](#150)    fn get_node(&self, id: &Id) -> Option<u32> {
[151](#151)        self.graph_ix.get_index_of(id).map(|ix| ix as _)
[152](#152)    }
[153](#153)
[154](#154)    fn node(&mut self, id: &Id) -> u32 {
[155](#155)        self.graph_ix.get_index_of(id).unwrap_or_else(|| {
[156](#156)            let ix = self.graph_ix.len();
[157](#157)            self.graph_ix.insert_full(id.clone());
[158](#158)            ix
[159](#159)        }) as _
[160](#160)    }
[161](#161)
[162](#162)    fn add_dep_edge(&mut self, from: &Id, to: &Id, assign: bool) {
[164](#164)        let from = self.node(from);
[165](#165)        let to = self.node(to);
[166](#166)
[167](#167)        match self.graph.edge_weight_mut(from, to) {
[168](#168)            Some(info) => {
[169](#169)                if assign {
[170](#170)                    info.assign += 1;
[171](#171)                } else {
[172](#172)                    info.usage += 1;
[173](#173)                }
[174](#174)            }
[175](#175)            None => {
[176](#176)                self.graph.add_edge(
[177](#177)                    from,
[178](#178)                    to,
[179](#179)                    VarInfo {
[180](#180)                        usage: u32::from(!assign),
[181](#181)                        assign: u32::from(assign),
[182](#182)                    },
[183](#183)                );
[184](#184)            }
[185](#185)        };
[186](#186)    }
[187](#187)
[188](#188)    fn subtract_cycles(&mut self) {
[190](#190)        let cycles = tarjan_scc(&self.graph);
[191](#191)
[192](#192)        'c: for cycle in cycles {
[193](#193)            if cycle.len() == 1 {
[194](#194)                continue;
[195](#195)            }
[196](#196)
[197](#197)            for &node in &cycle {
[200](#200)                if self.entries.contains(&node) {
[202](#202)                    continue 'c;
[203](#203)                }
[204](#204)
[205](#205)                if self.graph.neighbors_directed(node, Incoming).any(|source| {
[208](#208)                    !cycle.contains(&source)
[210](#210)                }) {
[211](#211)                    continue 'c;
[212](#212)                }
[213](#213)            }
[214](#214)
[215](#215)            for &i in &cycle {
[216](#216)                for &j in &cycle {
[217](#217)                    if i == j {
[218](#218)                        continue;
[219](#219)                    }
[220](#220)
[221](#221)                    let id = self.graph_ix.get_index(j as _);
[222](#222)                    let id = match id {
[223](#223)                        Some(id) => id,
[224](#224)                        None => continue,
[225](#225)                    };
[226](#226)
[227](#227)                    if let Some(w) = self.graph.edge_weight(i, j) {
[228](#228)                        let e = self.used_names.entry(id.clone()).or_default();
[229](#229)                        e.usage -= w.usage;
[230](#230)                        e.assign -= w.assign;
[231](#231)                    }
[232](#232)                }
[233](#233)            }
[234](#234)        }
[235](#235)    }
[236](#236)}
[237](#237)
[238](#238)impl Data {
[240](#240)    fn drop_ast_node<N>(&mut self, node: &N)
[241](#241)    where
[242](#242)        N: for<'aa> VisitWith<Dropper<'aa>>,
[243](#243)    {
[244](#244)        let mut dropper = Dropper { data: self };
[245](#245)
[246](#246)        node.visit_with(&mut dropper);
[247](#247)    }
[248](#248)}
[249](#249)
[250](#250)struct Dropper<'a> {
[251](#251)    data: &'a mut Data,
[252](#252)}
[253](#253)
[254](#254)impl<'a> Visit for Dropper<'a> {
[255](#255)    noop_visit_type!(fail);
[256](#256)
[257](#257)    fn visit_binding_ident(&mut self, node: &BindingIdent) {
[258](#258)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[259](#259)
[260](#260)        self.data.drop_assign(&node.to_id());
[261](#261)    }
[262](#262)
[263](#263)    fn visit_class_decl(&mut self, node: &ClassDecl) {
[264](#264)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[265](#265)
[266](#266)        self.data.drop_assign(&node.ident.to_id());
[267](#267)    }
[268](#268)
[269](#269)    fn visit_class_expr(&mut self, node: &ClassExpr) {
[270](#270)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[271](#271)
[272](#272)        if let Some(i) = &node.ident {
[273](#273)            self.data.drop_assign(&i.to_id());
[274](#274)        }
[275](#275)    }
[276](#276)
[277](#277)    fn visit_expr(&mut self, expr: &Expr) {
[278](#278)        expr.visit_children_with(self);
[279](#279)
[280](#280)        if let Expr::Ident(i) = expr {
[281](#281)            self.data.drop_usage(&i.to_id());
[282](#282)        }
[283](#283)    }
[284](#284)
[285](#285)    fn visit_fn_decl(&mut self, node: &FnDecl) {
[286](#286)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[287](#287)
[288](#288)        self.data.drop_assign(&node.ident.to_id());
[289](#289)    }
[290](#290)
[291](#291)    fn visit_fn_expr(&mut self, node: &FnExpr) {
[292](#292)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[293](#293)
[294](#294)        if let Some(i) = &node.ident {
[295](#295)            self.data.drop_assign(&i.to_id());
[296](#296)        }
[297](#297)    }

[300](#300)#[derive(Debug, Default)]
[301](#301)struct VarInfo {
[302](#302)    pub usage: u32,
[304](#304)    pub assign: u32,
[306](#306)}
[307](#307)
[308](#308)struct Analyzer<'a> {
[309](#309)    #[allow(dead_code)]
[310](#310)    config: &'a Config,
[311](#311)    in_var_decl: bool,
[312](#312)    scope: Scope<'a>,
[313](#313)    data: &'a mut Data,
[314](#314)    cur_class_id: Option<Id>,
[315](#315)    cur_fn_id: Option<Id>,
[316](#316)}
[317](#317)
[318](#318)#[derive(Debug, Default)]
[319](#319)struct Scope<'a> {
[320](#320)    parent: Option<&'a Scope<'a>>,
[321](#321)    kind: ScopeKind,
[322](#322)
[323](#323)    bindings_affected_by_eval: FxHashSet<Id>,
[324](#324)    found_direct_eval: bool,
[325](#325)
[326](#326)    found_arguemnts: bool,
[327](#327)    bindings_affected_by_arguements: Vec<Id>,
[328](#328)
[329](#329)    ast_path: Vec<Id>,
[333](#333)}
[334](#334)
[335](#335)#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
[336](#336)enum ScopeKind {
[337](#337)    Fn,
[338](#338)    ArrowFn,
[339](#339)}
[340](#340)
[341](#341)impl Default for ScopeKind {
[342](#342)    fn default() -> Self {
[343](#343)        Self::Fn
[344](#344)    }
[345](#345)}
[346](#346)
[347](#347)impl Analyzer<'_> {
[348](#348)    fn with_ast_path<F>(&mut self, ids: Vec<Id>, op: F)
[349](#349)    where
[350](#350)        F: for<'aa> FnOnce(&mut Analyzer<'aa>),
[351](#351)    {
[352](#352)        let prev_len = self.scope.ast_path.len();
[353](#353)
[354](#354)        self.scope.ast_path.extend(ids);
[355](#355)
[356](#356)        op(self);
[357](#357)
[358](#358)        self.scope.ast_path.truncate(prev_len);
[359](#359)    }
[360](#360)
[361](#361)    fn with_scope<F>(&mut self, kind: ScopeKind, op: F)
[362](#362)    where
[363](#363)        F: for<'aa> FnOnce(&mut Analyzer<'aa>),
[364](#364)    {
[365](#365)        let child_scope = {
[366](#366)            let child = Scope {
[367](#367)                parent: Some(&self.scope),
[368](#368)                ..Default::default()
[369](#369)            };
[370](#370)
[371](#371)            let mut v = Analyzer {
[372](#372)                scope: child,
[373](#373)                data: self.data,
[374](#374)                cur_fn_id: self.cur_fn_id.clone(),
[375](#375)                cur_class_id: self.cur_class_id.clone(),
[376](#376)                ..*self
[377](#377)            };
[378](#378)
[379](#379)            op(&mut v);
[380](#380)
[381](#381)            Scope {
[382](#382)                parent: None,
[383](#383)                ..v.scope
[384](#384)            }
[385](#385)        };
[386](#386)
[387](#387)        if child_scope.found_direct_eval {
[389](#389)            for id in child_scope.bindings_affected_by_eval {
[390](#390)                self.data.used_names.entry(id).or_default().usage += 1;
[391](#391)            }
[392](#392)
[393](#393)            self.scope.found_direct_eval = true;
[394](#394)        }
[395](#395)
[396](#396)        if child_scope.found_arguemnts {
[397](#397)            for id in child_scope.bindings_affected_by_arguements {
[400](#400)                self.data.used_names.entry(id).or_default().usage += 1;
[401](#401)            }
[402](#402)
[403](#403)            if !matches!(kind, ScopeKind::Fn) {
[404](#404)                self.scope.found_arguemnts = true;
[405](#405)            }
[406](#406)        }
[407](#407)    }
[408](#408)
[409](#409)    fn add(&mut self, id: Id, assign: bool) {
[411](#411)        if id.0 == atom!("arguments") {
[412](#412)            self.scope.found_arguemnts = true;
[413](#413)        }
[414](#414)
[415](#415)        if let Some(f) = &self.cur_fn_id {
[416](#416)            if id == *f {
[417](#417)                return;
[418](#418)            }
[419](#419)        }
[420](#420)        if let Some(f) = &self.cur_class_id {
[421](#421)            if id == *f {
[422](#422)                return;
[423](#423)            }
[424](#424)        }
[425](#425)
[426](#426)        if self.scope.is_ast_path_empty() {
[427](#427)            let idx = self.data.node(&id);
[429](#429)            self.data.entries.insert(idx);
[430](#430)        } else {
[431](#431)            let mut scope = Some(&self.scope);
[432](#432)
[433](#433)            while let Some(s) = scope {
[434](#434)                for component in &s.ast_path {
[435](#435)                    self.data.add_dep_edge(component, &id, assign);
[436](#436)                }
[437](#437)
[438](#438)                if s.kind == ScopeKind::Fn && !s.ast_path.is_empty() {
[439](#439)                    break;
[440](#440)                }
[441](#441)
[442](#442)                scope = s.parent;
[443](#443)            }
[444](#444)        }
[445](#445)
[446](#446)        if assign {
[447](#447)            self.data.used_names.entry(id).or_default().assign += 1;
[448](#448)        } else {
[449](#449)            self.data.used_names.entry(id).or_default().usage += 1;
[450](#450)        }
[451](#451)    }
[452](#452)}
[453](#453)
[454](#454)impl Visit for Analyzer<'_> {
[455](#455)    noop_visit_type!();
[456](#456)
[457](#457)    fn visit_callee(&mut self, n: &Callee) {
[458](#458)        n.visit_children_with(self);
[459](#459)
[460](#460)        if let Callee::Expr(e) = n {
[461](#461)            if e.is_ident_ref_to("eval") {
[462](#462)                self.scope.found_direct_eval = true;
[463](#463)            }
[464](#464)        }
[465](#465)    }
[466](#466)
[467](#467)    fn visit_assign_pat_prop(&mut self, n: &AssignPatProp) {
[468](#468)        n.visit_children_with(self);
[469](#469)
[470](#470)        self.add(n.key.to_id(), true);
[471](#471)    }
[472](#472)
[473](#473)    fn visit_class_decl(&mut self, n: &ClassDecl) {
[474](#474)        if let Some(super_class) = &n.class.super_class {
[475](#475)            super_class.visit_with(self);
[476](#476)        }
[477](#477)
[478](#478)        self.with_ast_path(vec![n.ident.to_id()], |v| {
[479](#479)            let old = v.cur_class_id.take();
[480](#480)            v.cur_class_id = Some(n.ident.to_id());
[481](#481)            n.ident.visit_with(v);
[482](#482)            n.class.decorators.visit_with(v);
[483](#483)            n.class.body.visit_with(v);
[484](#484)            v.cur_class_id = old;
[485](#485)
[486](#486)            if !n.class.decorators.is_empty() {
[487](#487)                v.add(n.ident.to_id(), false);
[488](#488)            }
[489](#489)        })
[490](#490)    }
[491](#491)
[492](#492)    fn visit_class_expr(&mut self, n: &ClassExpr) {
[493](#493)        n.visit_children_with(self);
[494](#494)
[495](#495)        if !n.class.decorators.is_empty() {
[496](#496)            if let Some(i) = &n.ident {
[497](#497)                self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[498](#498)            }
[499](#499)        }
[500](#500)    }
[501](#501)
[502](#502)    fn visit_export_named_specifier(&mut self, n: &ExportNamedSpecifier) {
[503](#503)        if let ModuleExportName::Ident(orig) = &n.orig {
[504](#504)            self.add(orig.to_id(), false);
[505](#505)        }
[506](#506)    }
[507](#507)
[508](#508)    fn visit_export_decl(&mut self, n: &ExportDecl) {
[509](#509)        let name = match &n.decl {
[510](#510)            Decl::Class(c) => vec![c.ident.to_id()],
[511](#511)            Decl::Fn(f) => vec![f.ident.to_id()],
[512](#512)            Decl::Var(v) => v
[513](#513)                .decls
[514](#514)                .iter()
[515](#515)                .flat_map(|d| find_pat_ids(d).into_iter())
[516](#516)                .collect(),
[517](#517)            _ => Vec::new(),
[518](#518)        };
[519](#519)        for ident in name {
[520](#520)            self.add(ident, false);
[521](#521)        }
[522](#522)
[523](#523)        n.visit_children_with(self)
[524](#524)    }
[525](#525)
[526](#526)    fn visit_expr(&mut self, e: &Expr) {
[527](#527)        let old_in_var_decl = self.in_var_decl;
[528](#528)
[529](#529)        self.in_var_decl = false;
[530](#530)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[531](#531)
[532](#532)        if let Expr::Ident(i) = e {
[533](#533)            self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[534](#534)        }
[535](#535)
[536](#536)        self.in_var_decl = old_in_var_decl;
[537](#537)    }
[538](#538)
[539](#539)    fn visit_assign_expr(&mut self, n: &AssignExpr) {
[540](#540)        match n.op {
[541](#541)            op!("=") => {
[542](#542)                if let Some(i) = n.left.as_ident() {
[543](#543)                    self.add(i.to_id(), true);
[544](#544)                    n.right.visit_with(self);
[545](#545)                } else {
[546](#546)                    n.visit_children_with(self);
[547](#547)                }
[548](#548)            }
[549](#549)            _ => {
[550](#550)                if let Some(i) = n.left.as_ident() {
[551](#551)                    self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[552](#552)                    self.add(i.to_id(), true);
[553](#553)                    n.right.visit_with(self);
[554](#554)                } else {
[555](#555)                    n.visit_children_with(self);
[556](#556)                }
[557](#557)            }
[558](#558)        }
[559](#559)    }
[560](#560)
[561](#561)    fn visit_jsx_element_name(&mut self, e: &JSXElementName) {
[562](#562)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[563](#563)
[564](#564)        if let JSXElementName::Ident(i) = e {
[565](#565)            self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[566](#566)        }
[567](#567)    }
[568](#568)
[569](#569)    fn visit_jsx_object(&mut self, e: &JSXObject) {
[570](#570)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[571](#571)
[572](#572)        if let JSXObject::Ident(i) = e {
[573](#573)            self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[574](#574)        }
[575](#575)    }
[576](#576)
[577](#577)    fn visit_arrow_expr(&mut self, n: &ArrowExpr) {
[578](#578)        self.with_scope(ScopeKind::ArrowFn, |v| {
[579](#579)            n.visit_children_with(v);
[580](#580)
[581](#581)            if v.scope.found_direct_eval {
[582](#582)                v.scope.bindings_affected_by_eval = collect_decls(n);
[583](#583)            }
[584](#584)        })
[585](#585)    }
[586](#586)
[587](#587)    fn visit_function(&mut self, n: &Function) {
[588](#588)        self.with_scope(ScopeKind::Fn, |v| {
[589](#589)            n.visit_children_with(v);
[590](#590)
[591](#591)            if v.scope.found_direct_eval {
[592](#592)                v.scope.bindings_affected_by_eval = collect_decls(n);
[593](#593)            }
[594](#594)
[595](#595)            if v.scope.found_arguemnts {
[596](#596)                v.scope.bindings_affected_by_arguements = find_pat_ids(&n.params);
[597](#597)            }
[598](#598)        })
[599](#599)    }
[600](#600)
[601](#601)    fn visit_fn_decl(&mut self, n: &FnDecl) {
[602](#602)        self.with_ast_path(vec![n.ident.to_id()], |v| {
[603](#603)            let old = v.cur_fn_id.take();
[604](#604)            v.cur_fn_id = Some(n.ident.to_id());
[605](#605)            n.visit_children_with(v);
[606](#606)            v.cur_fn_id = old;
[607](#607)
[608](#608)            if !n.function.decorators.is_empty() {
[609](#609)                v.add(n.ident.to_id(), false);
[610](#610)            }
[611](#611)        })
[612](#612)    }
[613](#613)
[614](#614)    fn visit_fn_expr(&mut self, n: &FnExpr) {
[615](#615)        n.visit_children_with(self);
[616](#616)
[617](#617)        if !n.function.decorators.is_empty() {
[618](#618)            if let Some(i) = &n.ident {
[619](#619)                self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[620](#620)            }
[621](#621)        }
[622](#622)    }
[623](#623)
[624](#624)    fn visit_pat(&mut self, p: &Pat) {
[625](#625)        p.visit_children_with(self);
[626](#626)
[627](#627)        if !self.in_var_decl {
[628](#628)            if let Pat::Ident(i) = p {
[629](#629)                self.add(i.to_id(), true);
[630](#630)            }
[631](#631)        }
[632](#632)    }
[633](#633)
[634](#634)    fn visit_prop(&mut self, p: &Prop) {
[635](#635)        p.visit_children_with(self);
[636](#636)
[637](#637)        if let Prop::Shorthand(i) = p {
[638](#638)            self.add(i.to_id(), false);
[639](#639)        }
[640](#640)    }
[641](#641)
[642](#642)    fn visit_var_declarator(&mut self, n: &VarDeclarator) {
[643](#643)        let old = self.in_var_decl;
[644](#644)
[645](#645)        self.in_var_decl = true;
[646](#646)        n.name.visit_with(self);
[647](#647)
[648](#648)        self.in_var_decl = false;
[649](#649)        n.init.visit_with(self);
[650](#650)
[651](#651)        self.in_var_decl = old;
[652](#652)    }
[653](#653)}
[654](#654)
[655](#655)impl Repeated for TreeShaker {
[656](#656)    fn changed(&self) -> bool {
[657](#657)        self.changed
[658](#658)    }
[659](#659)
[660](#660)    fn reset(&mut self) {
[661](#661)        self.pass += 1;
[662](#662)        self.changed = false;
[663](#663)    }
[664](#664)}
[665](#665)
[666](#666)impl TreeShaker {
[667](#667)    fn visit_mut_stmt_likes<T>(&mut self, stmts: &mut Vec<T>)
[668](#668)    where
[669](#669)        T: StmtLike + ModuleItemLike + VisitMutWith<Self> + Send + Sync,
[670](#670)        Vec<T>: VisitMutWith<Self>,
[671](#671)    {
[672](#672)        if let Some(Stmt::Expr(ExprStmt { expr, .. })) = stmts.first().and_then(|s| s.as_stmt()) {
[673](#673)            if let Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(v)) = &**expr {
[674](#674)                if &*v.value == "use asm" {
[675](#675)                    return;
[676](#676)                }
[677](#677)            }
[678](#678)        }
[679](#679)
[680](#680)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count() * 8, stmts);
[681](#681)
[682](#682)        stmts.retain(|s| match s.as_stmt() {
[683](#683)            Some(Stmt::Empty(..)) => false,
[684](#684)            Some(Stmt::Block(s)) if s.is_empty() => {
[685](#685)                debug!("Dropping an empty block statement");
[686](#686)                false
[687](#687)            }
[688](#688)            _ => true,
[689](#689)        });
[690](#690)    }
[691](#691)
[692](#692)    fn can_drop_binding(&self, name: Id, is_var: bool) -> bool {
[693](#693)        if !self.config.top_level {
[694](#694)            if is_var {
[695](#695)                if !self.in_fn {
[696](#696)                    return false;
[697](#697)                }
[698](#698)            } else if !self.in_block_stmt {
[699](#699)                return false;
[700](#700)            }
[701](#701)        }
[702](#702)
[703](#703)        if self.config.top_retain.contains(&name.0) {
[704](#704)            return false;
[705](#705)        }
[706](#706)
[707](#707)        match self.data.used_names.get(&name) {
[708](#708)            Some(v) => v.usage == 0 && v.assign == 0,
[709](#709)            None => true,
[710](#710)        }
[711](#711)    }
[712](#712)
[713](#713)    fn can_drop_assignment_to(&self, name: Id, is_var: bool) -> bool {
[714](#714)        if !self.config.top_level {
[715](#715)            if is_var {
[716](#716)                if !self.in_fn {
[717](#717)                    return false;
[718](#718)                }
[719](#719)            } else if !self.in_block_stmt {
[720](#720)                return false;
[721](#721)            }
[722](#722)
[723](#723)            let ix = self.data.graph_ix.get_index_of(&name);
[725](#725)            if let Some(ix) = ix {
[726](#726)                if self.data.entries.contains(&(ix as u32)) {
[727](#727)                    return false;
[728](#728)                }
[729](#729)            }
[730](#730)        }
[731](#731)
[732](#732)        if self.config.top_retain.contains(&name.0) {
[733](#733)            return false;
[734](#734)        }
[735](#735)
[736](#736)        self.expr_ctx.unresolved_ctxt != name.1
[738](#738)            && self
[739](#739)                .data
[740](#740)                .used_names
[741](#741)                .get(&name)
[742](#742)                .map(|v| v.usage == 0)
[743](#743)                .unwrap_or_default()
[744](#744)    }
[745](#745)
[746](#746)    fn optimize_bin_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Expr) {
[748](#748)        let Expr::Bin(b) = n else {
[749](#749)            return;
[750](#750)        };
[751](#751)
[752](#752)        if b.op == op!("&&") && b.left.as_pure_bool(self.expr_ctx) == Known(false) {
[753](#753)            self.data.drop_ast_node(&b.right);
[754](#754)            *n = *b.left.take();
[755](#755)            self.changed = true;
[756](#756)            return;
[757](#757)        }
[758](#758)
[759](#759)        if b.op == op!("||") && b.left.as_pure_bool(self.expr_ctx) == Known(true) {
[760](#760)            self.data.drop_ast_node(&b.right);
[761](#761)            *n = *b.left.take();
[762](#762)            self.changed = true;
[763](#763)        }
[764](#764)    }
[765](#765)
[766](#766)    fn visit_mut_par<N>(&mut self, _threshold: usize, nodes: &mut [N])
[767](#767)    where
[768](#768)        N: Send + Sync + VisitMutWith<Self>,
[769](#769)    {
[770](#770)        for n in nodes {
[771](#771)            n.visit_mut_with(self);
[772](#772)        }
[773](#773)    }
[774](#774)}
[775](#775)
[776](#776)impl VisitMut for TreeShaker {
[777](#777)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[778](#778)
[779](#779)    fn visit_mut_assign_expr(&mut self, n: &mut AssignExpr) {
[780](#780)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[781](#781)
[782](#782)        if let Some(id) = n.left.as_ident() {
[783](#783)            if self.can_drop_assignment_to(id.to_id(), false)
[785](#785)                && !n.right.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx)
[786](#786)            {
[787](#787)                self.changed = true;
[788](#788)                debug!("Dropping an assignment to `{}` because it's not used", id);
[789](#789)                self.data.drop_ast_node(&n.left);
[790](#790)
[791](#791)                n.left.take();
[792](#792)            }
[793](#793)        }
[794](#794)    }
[795](#795)
[796](#796)    fn visit_mut_block_stmt(&mut self, n: &mut BlockStmt) {
[797](#797)        let old_in_block_stmt = self.in_block_stmt;
[798](#798)        self.in_block_stmt = true;
[799](#799)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[800](#800)        self.in_block_stmt = old_in_block_stmt;
[801](#801)    }
[802](#802)
[803](#803)    fn visit_mut_block_stmt_or_expr(&mut self, n: &mut BlockStmtOrExpr) {
[804](#804)        let old_in_fn = self.in_fn;
[805](#805)        self.in_fn = true;
[806](#806)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[807](#807)        self.in_fn = old_in_fn;
[808](#808)    }

[810](#810)    fn visit_mut_class_members(&mut self, members: &mut Vec<ClassMember>) {
[811](#811)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count() * 8, members);
[812](#812)    }
[813](#813)
[814](#814)    fn visit_mut_decl(&mut self, n: &mut Decl) {
[815](#815)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[816](#816)
[817](#817)        match n {
[818](#818)            Decl::Fn(f) => {
[819](#819)                if self.can_drop_binding(f.ident.to_id(), true) {
[820](#820)                    debug!("Dropping function `{}` as it's not used", f.ident);
[821](#821)                    self.changed = true;
[822](#822)
[823](#823)                    self.data.drop_ast_node(&*f);
[824](#824)
[825](#825)                    n.take();
[826](#826)                }
[827](#827)            }
[828](#828)            Decl::Class(c) => {
[829](#829)                if self.can_drop_binding(c.ident.to_id(), false)
[830](#830)                    && c.class
[831](#831)                        .super_class
[832](#832)                        .as_deref()
[833](#833)                        .map_or(true, |e| !e.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx))
[834](#834)                    && c.class.body.iter().all(|m| match m {
[835](#835)                        ClassMember::Method(m) => !matches!(m.key, PropName::Computed(..)),
[836](#836)                        ClassMember::ClassProp(m) => {
[837](#837)                            !matches!(m.key, PropName::Computed(..))
[838](#838)                                && !m
[839](#839)                                    .value
[840](#840)                                    .as_deref()
[841](#841)                                    .is_some_and(|e| e.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx))
[842](#842)                        }
[843](#843)                        ClassMember::AutoAccessor(m) => {
[844](#844)                            !matches!(m.key, Key::Public(PropName::Computed(..)))
[845](#845)                                && !m
[846](#846)                                    .value
[847](#847)                                    .as_deref()
[848](#848)                                    .is_some_and(|e| e.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx))
[849](#849)                        }
[850](#850)
[851](#851)                        ClassMember::PrivateProp(m) => !m
[852](#852)                            .value
[853](#853)                            .as_deref()
[854](#854)                            .is_some_and(|e| e.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx)),
[855](#855)
[856](#856)                        ClassMember::StaticBlock(_) => false,
[857](#857)
[858](#858)                        ClassMember::TsIndexSignature(_)
[859](#859)                        | ClassMember::Empty(_)
[860](#860)                        | ClassMember::Constructor(_)
[861](#861)                        | ClassMember::PrivateMethod(_) => true,
[862](#862)                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[863](#863)                        _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[864](#864)                    })
[865](#865)                {
[866](#866)                    debug!("Dropping class `{}` as it's not used", c.ident);
[867](#867)                    self.changed = true;
[868](#868)
[869](#869)                    self.data.drop_ast_node(&*c);
[870](#870)                    n.take();
[871](#871)                }
[872](#872)            }
[873](#873)            _ => {}
[874](#874)        }
[875](#875)    }
[876](#876)
[877](#877)    fn visit_mut_export_decl(&mut self, n: &mut ExportDecl) {
[878](#878)        match &mut n.decl {
[879](#879)            Decl::Var(v) => {
[880](#880)                for decl in v.decls.iter_mut() {
[881](#881)                    decl.init.visit_mut_with(self);
[882](#882)                }
[883](#883)            }
[884](#884)            _ => {
[885](#885)                n.decl.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[887](#887)            }
[888](#888)        }
[889](#889)    }
[890](#890)
[891](#891)    fn visit_mut_export_default_decl(&mut self, _: &mut ExportDefaultDecl) {}
[893](#893)
[894](#894)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Expr) {
[895](#895)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[896](#896)
[897](#897)        self.optimize_bin_expr(n);
[898](#898)
[899](#899)        if let Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[900](#900)            callee: Callee::Expr(callee),
[901](#901)            args,
[902](#902)            ..
[903](#903)        }) = n
[904](#904)        {
[905](#905)            if args.is_empty() {
[907](#907)                match &mut **callee {
[908](#908)                    Expr::Fn(FnExpr {
[909](#909)                        ident: None,
[910](#910)                        function: f,
[911](#911)                    }) if matches!(
[912](#912)                        &**f,
[913](#913)                        Function {
[914](#914)                            is_async: false,
[915](#915)                            is_generator: false,
[916](#916)                            body: Some(..),
[917](#917)                            ..
[918](#918)                        }
[919](#919)                    ) =>
[920](#920)                    {
[921](#921)                        if f.params.is_empty() && f.body.as_ref().unwrap().stmts.len() == 1 {
[922](#922)                            if let Stmt::Return(ReturnStmt { arg: Some(arg), .. }) =
[923](#923)                                &mut f.body.as_mut().unwrap().stmts[0]
[924](#924)                            {
[925](#925)                                if let Expr::Object(ObjectLit { props, .. }) = &**arg {
[926](#926)                                    if props.iter().all(|p| match p {
[927](#927)                                        PropOrSpread::Spread(_) => false,
[928](#928)                                        PropOrSpread::Prop(p) => match &**p {
[929](#929)                                            Prop::Shorthand(_) => true,
[930](#930)                                            Prop::KeyValue(p) => p.value.is_ident(),
[931](#931)                                            _ => false,
[932](#932)                                        },
[933](#933)                                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[934](#934)                                        _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[935](#935)                                    }) {
[936](#936)                                        self.changed = true;
[937](#937)                                        debug!("Dropping a wrapped esm");
[938](#938)                                        *n = *arg.take();
[939](#939)                                        return;
[940](#940)                                    }
[941](#941)                                }
[942](#942)                            }
[943](#943)                        }
[944](#944)                    }
[945](#945)                    _ => (),
[946](#946)                }
[947](#947)            }
[948](#948)        }
[949](#949)
[950](#950)        if let Expr::Assign(a) = n {
[951](#951)            if match &a.left {
[952](#952)                AssignTarget::Simple(l) => l.is_invalid(),
[953](#953)                AssignTarget::Pat(l) => l.is_invalid(),
[954](#954)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[955](#955)                _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[956](#956)            } {
[957](#957)                *n = *a.right.take();
[958](#958)            }
[959](#959)        }
[960](#960)
[961](#961)        if !n.is_invalid() {
[962](#962)            debug_assert_valid(n);
[963](#963)        }
[964](#964)    }
[965](#965)
[966](#966)    fn visit_mut_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ExprOrSpread>) {
[967](#967)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count() * 8, n);
[968](#968)    }
[969](#969)
[970](#970)    fn visit_mut_exprs(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Box<Expr>>) {

[977](#977)            ForHead::Pat(v) => {

[981](#981)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[982](#982)        }
[983](#983)    }

[992](#992)    fn visit_mut_import_specifiers(&mut self, ss: &mut Vec<ImportSpecifier>) {
[993](#993)        ss.retain(|s| {
[994](#994)            let local = match s {
[995](#995)                ImportSpecifier::Named(l) => &l.local,
[996](#996)                ImportSpecifier::Default(l) => &l.local,
[997](#997)                ImportSpecifier::Namespace(l) => &l.local,
[998](#998)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[999](#999)                _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[1000](#1000)            };
[1001](#1001)
[1002](#1002)            if self.can_drop_binding(local.to_id(), false) {
[1003](#1003)                debug!(
[1004](#1004)                    "Dropping import specifier `{}` because it's not used",
[1005](#1005)                    local
[1006](#1006)                );
[1007](#1007)                self.changed = true;
[1008](#1008)                return false;
[1009](#1009)            }
[1010](#1010)
[1011](#1011)            true
[1012](#1012)        });
[1013](#1013)    }
[1014](#1014)
[1015](#1015)    fn visit_mut_module(&mut self, m: &mut Module) {
[1016](#1016)        debug_assert_valid(m);
[1017](#1017)
[1018](#1018)        let _tracing = span!(Level::ERROR, "tree-shaker", pass = self.pass).entered();
[1019](#1019)
[1020](#1020)        if !self.data.initialized {
[1021](#1021)            let mut data = Data {
[1022](#1022)                initialized: true,
[1023](#1023)                ..Default::default()
[1024](#1024)            };
[1025](#1025)
[1026](#1026)            {
[1027](#1027)                let mut analyzer = Analyzer {
[1028](#1028)                    config: &self.config,
[1029](#1029)                    in_var_decl: false,
[1030](#1030)                    scope: Default::default(),
[1031](#1031)                    data: &mut data,
[1032](#1032)                    cur_class_id: Default::default(),
[1033](#1033)                    cur_fn_id: Default::default(),
[1034](#1034)                };
[1035](#1035)                m.visit_with(&mut analyzer);
[1036](#1036)            }
[1037](#1037)            data.subtract_cycles();
[1038](#1038)            self.data = data;
[1039](#1039)        } else {
[1040](#1040)            self.data.subtract_cycles();
[1041](#1041)        }
[1042](#1042)
[1043](#1043)        m.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1044](#1044)    }
[1045](#1045)
[1046](#1046)    fn visit_mut_module_item(&mut self, n: &mut ModuleItem) {
[1047](#1047)        match n {
[1048](#1048)            ModuleItem::ModuleDecl(ModuleDecl::Import(i)) => {
[1049](#1049)                let is_for_side_effect = i.specifiers.is_empty();
[1050](#1050)
[1051](#1051)                i.visit_mut_with(self);
[1052](#1052)
[1053](#1053)                if !self.config.preserve_imports_with_side_effects
[1054](#1054)                    && !is_for_side_effect
[1055](#1055)                    && i.specifiers.is_empty()
[1056](#1056)                {
[1057](#1057)                    debug!("Dropping an import because it's not used");
[1058](#1058)                    self.changed = true;
[1059](#1059)                    *n = EmptyStmt { span: DUMMY_SP }.into();
[1060](#1060)                }
[1061](#1061)            }
[1062](#1062)            _ => {
[1063](#1063)                n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1064](#1064)            }
[1065](#1065)        }
[1066](#1066)        debug_assert_valid(n);
[1067](#1067)    }

[1081](#1081)    fn visit_mut_script(&mut self, m: &mut Script) {
[1082](#1082)        let _tracing = span!(Level::ERROR, "tree-shaker", pass = self.pass).entered();
[1083](#1083)
[1084](#1084)        if !self.data.initialized {
[1085](#1085)            let mut data = Data {
[1086](#1086)                initialized: true,
[1087](#1087)                ..Default::default()
[1088](#1088)            };
[1089](#1089)
[1090](#1090)            {
[1091](#1091)                let mut analyzer = Analyzer {
[1092](#1092)                    config: &self.config,
[1093](#1093)                    in_var_decl: false,
[1094](#1094)                    scope: Default::default(),
[1095](#1095)                    data: &mut data,
[1096](#1096)                    cur_class_id: Default::default(),
[1097](#1097)                    cur_fn_id: Default::default(),
[1098](#1098)                };
[1099](#1099)                m.visit_with(&mut analyzer);
[1100](#1100)            }
[1101](#1101)            data.subtract_cycles();
[1102](#1102)            self.data = data;
[1103](#1103)        } else {
[1104](#1104)            self.data.subtract_cycles();
[1105](#1105)        }
[1106](#1106)
[1107](#1107)        m.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1108](#1108)    }
[1109](#1109)
[1110](#1110)    fn visit_mut_stmt(&mut self, s: &mut Stmt) {
[1111](#1111)        s.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1112](#1112)
[1113](#1113)        if let Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(v)) = s {
[1114](#1114)            if v.decls.is_empty() {
[1115](#1115)                s.take();
[1116](#1116)                return;
[1117](#1117)            }
[1118](#1118)        }
[1119](#1119)
[1120](#1120)        debug_assert_valid(s);
[1121](#1121)
[1122](#1122)        if let Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(v)) = s {
[1123](#1123)            let span = v.span;
[1124](#1124)            let cnt = v.decls.len();
[1125](#1125)
[1126](#1126)            if cnt != 0
[1128](#1128)                && v.decls.iter().all(|vd| match &vd.name {
[1129](#1129)                    Pat::Ident(i) => self.can_drop_binding(i.to_id(), v.kind == VarDeclKind::Var),
[1130](#1130)                    _ => false,
[1131](#1131)                })
[1132](#1132)            {
[1133](#1133)                for decl in v.decls.iter() {
[1134](#1134)                    self.data.drop_ast_node(&decl.name);
[1135](#1135)                }
[1136](#1136)
[1137](#1137)                let exprs = v
[1138](#1138)                    .decls
[1139](#1139)                    .take()
[1140](#1140)                    .into_iter()
[1141](#1141)                    .filter_map(|v| v.init)
[1142](#1142)                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[1143](#1143)
[1144](#1144)                debug!(
[1145](#1145)                    count = cnt,
[1146](#1146)                    "Dropping names of variables as they are not used",
[1147](#1147)                );
[1148](#1148)                self.changed = true;
[1149](#1149)
[1150](#1150)                if exprs.is_empty() {
[1151](#1151)                    *s = EmptyStmt { span: DUMMY_SP }.into();
[1152](#1152)                    return;
[1153](#1153)                } else {
[1154](#1154)                    *s = ExprStmt {
[1155](#1155)                        span,
[1156](#1156)                        expr: Expr::from_exprs(exprs),
[1157](#1157)                    }
[1158](#1158)                    .into();
[1159](#1159)                }
[1160](#1160)            }
[1161](#1161)        }
[1162](#1162)
[1163](#1163)        if let Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(v)) = s {
[1164](#1164)            if v.decls.is_empty() {
[1165](#1165)                *s = EmptyStmt { span: DUMMY_SP }.into();
[1166](#1166)            }
[1167](#1167)        }
[1168](#1168)
[1169](#1169)        debug_assert_valid(s);
[1170](#1170)    }
[1171](#1171)
[1172](#1172)    fn visit_mut_stmts(&mut self, s: &mut Vec<Stmt>) {
[1173](#1173)        self.visit_mut_stmt_likes(s);
[1174](#1174)    }
[1175](#1175)
[1176](#1176)    fn visit_mut_unary_expr(&mut self, n: &mut UnaryExpr) {
[1177](#1177)        if matches!(n.op, op!("delete")) {
[1178](#1178)            return;
[1179](#1179)        }
[1180](#1180)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1181](#1181)    }
[1182](#1182)
[1183](#1183)    #[cfg_attr(feature = "debug", tracing::instrument(level = "debug", skip_all))]
[1184](#1184)    fn visit_mut_using_decl(&mut self, n: &mut UsingDecl) {

[1190](#1190)    fn visit_mut_var_decl(&mut self, n: &mut VarDecl) {

[1192](#1192)        self.var_decl_kind = Some(n.kind);
[1193](#1193)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);

[1197](#1197)    fn visit_mut_var_decl_or_expr(&mut self, n: &mut VarDeclOrExpr) {
[1198](#1198)        match n {
[1199](#1199)            VarDeclOrExpr::VarDecl(..) => {}
[1200](#1200)            VarDeclOrExpr::Expr(v) => {
[1201](#1201)                v.visit_mut_with(self);
[1202](#1202)            }
[1203](#1203)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]

[1205](#1205)        }
[1206](#1206)    }
[1207](#1207)
[1208](#1208)    fn visit_mut_var_declarator(&mut self, v: &mut VarDeclarator) {
[1209](#1209)        v.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[1210](#1210)
[1211](#1211)        if let Pat::Ident(i) = &v.name {
[1212](#1212)            let can_drop = if let Some(init) = &v.init {
[1213](#1213)                !init.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx)
[1214](#1214)            } else {
[1215](#1215)                true
[1216](#1216)            };
[1217](#1217)
[1218](#1218)            if can_drop
[1219](#1219)                && self.can_drop_binding(i.to_id(), self.var_decl_kind == Some(VarDeclKind::Var))
[1220](#1220)            {
[1221](#1221)                self.changed = true;
[1222](#1222)                debug!("Dropping {} because it's not used", i);
[1223](#1223)                self.data.drop_ast_node(&*v);
[1224](#1224)                v.name.take();
[1225](#1225)            }
[1226](#1226)        }
[1227](#1227)    }
[1228](#1228)
[1229](#1229)    fn visit_mut_var_declarators(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<VarDeclarator>) {
[1230](#1230)        self.visit_mut_par(cpu_count() * 8, n);
[1231](#1231)
[1232](#1232)        n.retain(|v| {
[1233](#1233)            if v.name.is_invalid() {
[1234](#1234)                return false;
[1235](#1235)            }
[1236](#1236)
[1237](#1237)            true
[1238](#1238)        });
[1239](#1239)    }
[1240](#1240)
[1241](#1241)    fn visit_mut_with_stmt(&mut self, n: &mut WithStmt) {
[1242](#1242)        n.obj.visit_mut_with(self);
[1243](#1243)    }
[1244](#1244)}
[1245](#1245)
[1246](#1246)impl Scope<'_> {
[1247](#1247)    fn is_ast_path_empty(&self) -> bool {
[1249](#1249)        if !self.ast_path.is_empty() {
[1250](#1250)            return false;
[1251](#1251)        }
[1252](#1252)        match &self.parent {
[1253](#1253)            Some(p) => p.is_ast_path_empty(),
[1254](#1254)            None => true,
[1255](#1255)        }
[1256](#1256)    }
[1257](#1257)}

[89](#89)    }

[91](#91)
[92](#92)impl Repeated for SimplifyExpr {
[93](#93)    fn changed(&self) -> bool {
[94](#94)        self.changed
[95](#95)    }
[96](#96)
[97](#97)    fn reset(&mut self) {
[98](#98)        self.changed = false;
[99](#99)    }
