[101](#101)
[102](#102)impl VisitMut for SimplifyExpr {
[103](#103)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[104](#104)
[105](#105)    fn visit_mut_assign_expr(&mut self, n: &mut AssignExpr) {
[106](#106)        let old = self.is_modifying;
[107](#107)        self.is_modifying = true;
[108](#108)        n.left.visit_mut_with(self);
[109](#109)        self.is_modifying = old;
[110](#110)
[111](#111)        self.is_modifying = false;
[112](#112)        n.right.visit_mut_with(self);
[113](#113)        self.is_modifying = old;
[114](#114)    }
[115](#115)
[116](#116)    fn visit_mut_call_expr(&mut self, n: &mut CallExpr) {
[118](#118)        let old_in_callee = self.in_callee;
[119](#119)
[120](#120)        self.in_callee = true;
[121](#121)        match &mut n.callee {
[122](#122)            Callee::Super(..) | Callee::Import(..) => {}
[123](#123)            Callee::Expr(e) => {
[124](#124)                let may_inject_zero = !need_zero_for_this(e);
[125](#125)
[126](#126)                match &mut **e {
[127](#127)                    Expr::Seq(seq) => {
[128](#128)                        if seq.exprs.len() == 1 {
[129](#129)                            let mut expr = seq.exprs.take().into_iter().next().unwrap();
[130](#130)                            expr.visit_mut_with(self);
[131](#131)                            *e = expr;
[132](#132)                        } else if seq
[133](#133)                            .exprs
[134](#134)                            .last()
[135](#135)                            .map(|v| &**v)
[136](#136)                            .is_some_and(Expr::directness_matters)
[137](#137)                        {
[138](#138)                            match seq.exprs.first().map(|v| &**v) {
[139](#139)                                Some(Expr::Lit(..) | Expr::Ident(..)) => {}
[140](#140)                                _ => {
[141](#141)                                    tracing::debug!("Injecting `0` to preserve `this = undefined`");
[142](#142)                                    seq.exprs.insert(0, 0.0.into());
[143](#143)                                }
[144](#144)                            }
[145](#145)
[146](#146)                            seq.visit_mut_with(self);
[147](#147)                        }
[148](#148)                    }
[149](#149)
[150](#150)                    _ => {
[151](#151)                        e.visit_mut_with(self);
[152](#152)                    }
[153](#153)                }
[154](#154)
[155](#155)                if may_inject_zero && need_zero_for_this(e) {
[156](#156)                    match &mut **e {
[157](#157)                        Expr::Seq(seq) => {
[158](#158)                            seq.exprs.insert(0, 0.into());
[159](#159)                        }
[160](#160)                        _ => {
[161](#161)                            let seq = SeqExpr {
[162](#162)                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[163](#163)                                exprs: vec![0.0.into(), e.take()],
[164](#164)                            };
[165](#165)                            **e = seq.into();
[166](#166)                        }
[167](#167)                    }
[168](#168)                }
[169](#169)            }
[170](#170)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[171](#171)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[172](#172)        }
[173](#173)
[174](#174)        self.in_callee = false;
[175](#175)        n.args.visit_mut_with(self);
[176](#176)
[177](#177)        self.in_callee = old_in_callee;
[178](#178)    }
[179](#179)
[180](#180)    fn visit_mut_class_members(&mut self, members: &mut Vec<ClassMember>) {
[181](#181)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), members, |v, member| {
[182](#182)            member.visit_mut_with(v);
[183](#183)        });
[184](#184)    }
[185](#185)
[186](#186)    fn visit_mut_export_default_expr(&mut self, expr: &mut ExportDefaultExpr) {
[187](#187)        fn is_paren_wrap_fn_or_class(expr: &mut Expr, visitor: &mut SimplifyExpr) -> bool {
[188](#188)            match &mut *expr {
[189](#189)                Expr::Fn(..) | Expr::Class(..) => {
[190](#190)                    expr.visit_mut_children_with(visitor);
[191](#191)                    true
[192](#192)                }
[193](#193)                Expr::Paren(p) => is_paren_wrap_fn_or_class(&mut p.expr, visitor),
[194](#194)                _ => false,
[195](#195)            }
[196](#196)        }
[197](#197)
[198](#198)        if !is_paren_wrap_fn_or_class(&mut expr.expr, self) {
[199](#199)            expr.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[200](#200)        }
[201](#201)    }
[202](#202)
[203](#203)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, expr: &mut Expr) {
[204](#204)        if let Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[205](#205)            op: op!("delete"), ..
[206](#206)        }) = expr
[207](#207)        {
[208](#208)            return;
[209](#209)        }
[210](#210)        expr.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[212](#212)
[213](#213)        match expr {
[214](#214)            Expr::Lit(_) | Expr::This(..) | Expr::Paren(..) => return,
[217](#217)
[218](#218)            Expr::Seq(seq) if seq.exprs.is_empty() => return,
[219](#219)
[220](#220)            Expr::Unary(..)
[221](#221)            | Expr::Bin(..)
[222](#222)            | Expr::Member(..)
[223](#223)            | Expr::Cond(..)
[224](#224)            | Expr::Seq(..)
[225](#225)            | Expr::Array(..)
[226](#226)            | Expr::Object(..)
[227](#227)            | Expr::New(..) => {}
[228](#228)
[229](#229)            _ => return,
[230](#230)        }
[231](#231)
[232](#232)        match expr {
[233](#233)            Expr::Unary(_) => {
[234](#234)                optimize_unary_expr(self.expr_ctx, expr, &mut self.changed);
[235](#235)                debug_assert_valid(expr);
[236](#236)            }
[237](#237)            Expr::Bin(_) => {
[238](#238)                optimize_bin_expr(self.expr_ctx, expr, &mut self.changed);
[239](#239)                if expr.is_seq() {
[240](#240)                    expr.visit_mut_with(self);
[241](#241)                }
[242](#242)
[243](#243)                debug_assert_valid(expr);
[244](#244)            }
[245](#245)            Expr::Member(_) => {
[246](#246)                if !self.is_modifying {
[247](#247)                    optimize_member_expr(self.expr_ctx, expr, self.in_callee, &mut self.changed);
[248](#248)
[249](#249)                    debug_assert_valid(expr);
[250](#250)                }
[251](#251)            }
[252](#252)
[253](#253)            Expr::Cond(CondExpr {
[254](#254)                span,
[255](#255)                test,
[256](#256)                cons,
[257](#257)                alt,
[258](#258)            }) => {
[259](#259)                if let (p, Known(val)) = test.cast_to_bool(self.expr_ctx) {
[260](#260)                    self.changed = true;
[261](#261)
[262](#262)                    let expr_value = if val { cons } else { alt };
[263](#263)                    *expr = if p.is_pure() {
[264](#264)                        if expr_value.directness_matters() {
[265](#265)                            SeqExpr {
[266](#266)                                span: *span,
[267](#267)                                exprs: vec![0.into(), expr_value.take()],
[268](#268)                            }
[269](#269)                            .into()
[270](#270)                        } else {
[271](#271)                            *expr_value.take()
[272](#272)                        }
[273](#273)                    } else {
[274](#274)                        SeqExpr {
[275](#275)                            span: *span,
[276](#276)                            exprs: vec![test.take(), expr_value.take()],
[277](#277)                        }
[278](#278)                        .into()
[279](#279)                    }
[280](#280)                }
[281](#281)            }
[282](#282)
[283](#283)            Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { exprs, .. }) => {
[285](#285)                if exprs.len() == 1 {
[286](#286)                    *expr = *exprs.take().into_iter().next().unwrap()
[288](#288)                } else {
[289](#289)                    assert!(!exprs.is_empty(), "sequence expression should not be empty");
[290](#290)                    }
[292](#292)            }
[293](#293)
[294](#294)            Expr::Array(ArrayLit { elems, .. }) => {
[295](#295)                let mut e = Vec::with_capacity(elems.len());
[296](#296)
[297](#297)                for elem in elems.take() {
[298](#298)                    match elem {
[299](#299)                        Some(ExprOrSpread {
[300](#300)                            spread: Some(..),
[301](#301)                            expr,
[302](#302)                        }) if expr.is_array() => {
[303](#303)                            self.changed = true;
[304](#304)
[305](#305)                            e.extend(expr.array().unwrap().elems.into_iter().map(|elem| {
[306](#306)                                Some(elem.unwrap_or_else(|| ExprOrSpread {
[307](#307)                                    spread: None,
[308](#308)                                    expr: Expr::undefined(DUMMY_SP),
[309](#309)                                }))
[310](#310)                            }));
[311](#311)                        }
[312](#312)
[313](#313)                        _ => e.push(elem),
[314](#314)                    }
[315](#315)                }
[316](#316)                *elems = e;
[317](#317)            }
[318](#318)
[319](#319)            Expr::Object(ObjectLit { props, .. }) => {
[320](#320)                let should_work = props.iter().any(|p| matches!(p, PropOrSpread::Spread(..)));
[321](#321)                if !should_work {
[322](#322)                    return;
[323](#323)                }
[324](#324)
[325](#325)                let mut ps = Vec::with_capacity(props.len());
[326](#326)
[327](#327)                for p in props.take() {
[328](#328)                    match p {
[329](#329)                        PropOrSpread::Spread(SpreadElement {
[330](#330)                            dot3_token, expr, ..
[331](#331)                        }) if expr.is_object() => {
[332](#332)                            if let Expr::Object(obj) = &*expr {
[333](#333)                                if obj.props.iter().any(|p| match p {
[334](#334)                                    PropOrSpread::Spread(..) => true,
[335](#335)                                    PropOrSpread::Prop(p) => !matches!(
[336](#336)                                        &**p,
[337](#337)                                        Prop::Shorthand(_) | Prop::KeyValue(_) | Prop::Method(_)
[338](#338)                                    ),
[339](#339)                                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[340](#340)                                    _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[341](#341)                                }) {
[342](#342)                                    ps.push(PropOrSpread::Spread(SpreadElement {
[343](#343)                                        dot3_token,
[344](#344)                                        expr,
[345](#345)                                    }));
[346](#346)                                    continue;
[347](#347)                                }
[348](#348)                            }
[349](#349)                            let props = expr.object().unwrap().props;
[350](#350)                            ps.extend(props);
[351](#351)                            self.changed = true;
[352](#352)                        }
[353](#353)
[354](#354)                        _ => ps.push(p),
[355](#355)                    }
[356](#356)                }
[357](#357)                *props = ps;
[358](#358)            }
[359](#359)
[360](#360)            _ => {}
[362](#362)        };
[363](#363)    }
[364](#364)
[365](#365)    fn visit_mut_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ExprOrSpread>) {
[366](#366)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[367](#367)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[368](#368)        });
[369](#369)    }
[370](#370)
[371](#371)    fn visit_mut_exprs(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Box<Expr>>) {
[372](#372)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[373](#373)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[374](#374)        });
[375](#375)    }
[376](#376)
[377](#377)    fn visit_mut_for_head(&mut self, n: &mut ForHead) {
[378](#378)        let old = self.is_modifying;
[379](#379)        self.is_modifying = true;
[380](#380)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[381](#381)        self.is_modifying = old;
[382](#382)    }
[383](#383)
[384](#384)    fn visit_mut_module_items(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ModuleItem>) {
[385](#385)        let mut child = SimplifyExpr {
[386](#386)            expr_ctx: self.expr_ctx,
[387](#387)            config: self.config,
[388](#388)            changed: Default::default(),
[389](#389)            is_arg_of_update: Default::default(),
[390](#390)            is_modifying: Default::default(),
[391](#391)            in_callee: Default::default(),
[392](#392)        };
[393](#393)
[394](#394)        child.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[395](#395)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[396](#396)        });
[397](#397)        self.changed |= child.changed;
[398](#398)    }
[399](#399)
[400](#400)    #[inline]
[402](#402)    fn visit_mut_opt_chain_expr(&mut self, _: &mut OptChainExpr) {}
[403](#403)
[404](#404)    fn visit_mut_opt_var_decl_or_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Option<VarDeclOrExpr>) {
[405](#405)        if let Some(VarDeclOrExpr::Expr(e)) = n {
[406](#406)            match &mut **e {
[407](#407)                Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { exprs, .. }) if exprs.is_empty() => {
[408](#408)                    *n = None;
[409](#409)                    return;
[410](#410)                }
[411](#411)                _ => {}
[412](#412)            }
[413](#413)        }
[414](#414)
[415](#415)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[416](#416)    }
[417](#417)
[418](#418)    fn visit_mut_opt_vec_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Option<ExprOrSpread>>) {
[419](#419)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[420](#420)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[421](#421)        });
[422](#422)    }
[423](#423)
[424](#424)    fn visit_mut_pat(&mut self, p: &mut Pat) {
[425](#425)        let old_in_callee = self.in_callee;
[426](#426)        self.in_callee = false;
[427](#427)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[428](#428)        self.in_callee = old_in_callee;
[429](#429)
[430](#430)        if let Pat::Assign(a) = p {
[431](#431)            if a.right.is_undefined(self.expr_ctx)
[432](#432)                || match *a.right {
[433](#433)                    Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[434](#434)                        op: op!("void"),
[435](#435)                        ref arg,
[436](#436)                        ..
[437](#437)                    }) => !arg.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx),
[438](#438)                    _ => false,
[439](#439)                }
[440](#440)            {
[441](#441)                self.changed = true;
[442](#442)                *p = *a.left.take();
[443](#443)            }
[444](#444)        }
[445](#445)    }
[446](#446)
[447](#447)    fn visit_mut_prop_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<PropOrSpread>) {
[448](#448)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[449](#449)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[450](#450)        });
[451](#451)    }
[452](#452)
[453](#453)    fn visit_mut_seq_expr(&mut self, e: &mut SeqExpr) {
[455](#455)        if e.exprs.is_empty() {
[456](#456)            return;
[457](#457)        }
[458](#458)
[459](#459)        let old_in_callee = self.in_callee;
[460](#460)        let len = e.exprs.len();
[461](#461)        for (idx, e) in e.exprs.iter_mut().enumerate() {
[462](#462)            if idx == len - 1 {
[463](#463)                self.in_callee = old_in_callee;
[464](#464)            } else {
[465](#465)                self.in_callee = false;
[466](#466)            }
[467](#467)
[468](#468)            e.visit_mut_with(self);
[469](#469)        }
[470](#470)        self.in_callee = old_in_callee;
[471](#471)
[472](#472)        let len = e.exprs.len();
[473](#473)
[474](#474)        let last_expr = e.exprs.pop().expect("SeqExpr.exprs must not be empty");
[475](#475)
[476](#476)        let mut exprs = Vec::with_capacity(e.exprs.len() + 1);
[478](#478)
[479](#479)        for expr in e.exprs.take() {
[480](#480)            match *expr {
[481](#481)                Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(n)) if self.in_callee && n.value == 0.0 => {
[482](#482)                    if exprs.is_empty() {
[483](#483)                        exprs.push(0.0.into());
[484](#484)
[485](#485)                        tracing::trace!("expr_simplifier: Preserving first zero");
[486](#486)                    }
[487](#487)                }
[488](#488)
[489](#489)                Expr::Lit(..) | Expr::Ident(..)
[490](#490)                    if self.in_callee && !expr.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx) =>
[491](#491)                {
[492](#492)                    if exprs.is_empty() {
[493](#493)                        self.changed = true;
[494](#494)
[495](#495)                        exprs.push(0.0.into());
[496](#496)
[497](#497)                        tracing::debug!("expr_simplifier: Injected first zero");
[498](#498)                    }
[499](#499)                }
[500](#500)
[501](#501)                Expr::Lit(_) => {}
[503](#503)
[504](#504)                Expr::Array(ArrayLit { span, elems }) => {
[506](#506)                    let is_simple = elems
[507](#507)                        .iter()
[508](#508)                        .all(|elem| matches!(elem, None | Some(ExprOrSpread { spread: None, .. })));
[509](#509)
[510](#510)                    if is_simple {
[511](#511)                        exprs.extend(elems.into_iter().flatten().map(|e| e.expr));
[512](#512)                    } else {
[513](#513)                        exprs.push(Box::new(ArrayLit { span, elems }.into()));
[514](#514)                    }
[515](#515)                }
[516](#516)
[517](#517)                _ => exprs.push(expr),
[519](#519)            }
[520](#520)        }
[521](#521)
[522](#522)        exprs.push(last_expr);
[523](#523)
[524](#524)        self.changed |= len != exprs.len();
[525](#525)
[526](#526)        e.exprs = exprs;
[527](#527)    }
[528](#528)
[529](#529)    fn visit_mut_stmt(&mut self, s: &mut Stmt) {
[530](#530)        let old_is_modifying = self.is_modifying;
[531](#531)        self.is_modifying = false;
[532](#532)        let old_is_arg_of_update = self.is_arg_of_update;
[533](#533)        self.is_arg_of_update = false;
[534](#534)        s.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[535](#535)        self.is_arg_of_update = old_is_arg_of_update;
[536](#536)        self.is_modifying = old_is_modifying;
[537](#537)
[538](#538)        debug_assert_valid(s);
[539](#539)    }
[540](#540)
[541](#541)    fn visit_mut_stmts(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Stmt>) {
[542](#542)        let mut child = SimplifyExpr {
[543](#543)            expr_ctx: self.expr_ctx,
[544](#544)            config: self.config,
[545](#545)            changed: Default::default(),
[546](#546)            is_arg_of_update: Default::default(),
[547](#547)            is_modifying: Default::default(),
[548](#548)            in_callee: Default::default(),
[549](#549)        };
[550](#550)
[551](#551)        child.maybe_par(cpu_count(), n, |v, n| {
[552](#552)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[553](#553)        });
[554](#554)        self.changed |= child.changed;
[555](#555)    }
[556](#556)
[557](#557)    fn visit_mut_tagged_tpl(&mut self, n: &mut TaggedTpl) {
[558](#558)        let old = self.in_callee;
[559](#559)        self.in_callee = true;
[560](#560)
[561](#561)        n.tag.visit_mut_with(self);
[562](#562)
[563](#563)        self.in_callee = false;
[564](#564)        n.tpl.visit_mut_with(self);
[565](#565)
[566](#566)        self.in_callee = old;
[567](#567)    }
[568](#568)
[569](#569)    fn visit_mut_update_expr(&mut self, n: &mut UpdateExpr) {
[570](#570)        let old = self.is_modifying;
[571](#571)        self.is_modifying = true;
[572](#572)        n.arg.visit_mut_with(self);
[573](#573)        self.is_modifying = old;
[574](#574)    }
[575](#575)
[576](#576)    fn visit_mut_with_stmt(&mut self, n: &mut WithStmt) {
[577](#577)        n.obj.visit_mut_with(self);
[578](#578)    }
[579](#579)}

[581](#581)fn make_bool_expr<I>(ctx: ExprCtx, span: Span, value: bool, orig: I) -> Box<Expr>
[583](#583)where
[584](#584)    I: IntoIterator<Item = Box<Expr>>,
[585](#585){
[586](#586)    ctx.preserve_effects(span, Lit::Bool(Bool { value, span }).into(), orig)
[587](#587)}
[588](#588)
[589](#589)fn nth_char(s: &Wtf8, idx: usize) -> CodePoint {
[593](#593)    match s.to_ill_formed_utf16().nth(idx) {
[594](#594)        Some(c) =>
[595](#595)        unsafe { CodePoint::from_u32_unchecked(c as u32) },
[597](#597)        None => unreachable!("string is too short"),
[598](#598)    }
[599](#599)}
[600](#600)
[601](#601)fn need_zero_for_this(e: &Expr) -> bool {
[602](#602)    e.directness_matters() || e.is_seq()
[603](#603)}
[604](#604)
[605](#605)fn get_key_value(key: &str, props: &mut Vec<PropOrSpread>) -> Option<Box<Expr>> {
[609](#609)    let has_spread = props.iter().any(|prop| prop.is_spread());
[611](#611)
[612](#612)    if has_spread {
[613](#613)        return None;
[614](#614)    }
[615](#615)
[616](#616)    for (i, prop) in props.iter_mut().enumerate().rev() {
[617](#617)        let prop = match prop {
[618](#618)            PropOrSpread::Prop(x) => &mut **x,
[619](#619)            PropOrSpread::Spread(_) => unreachable!(),
[620](#620)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[621](#621)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[622](#622)        };
[623](#623)
[624](#624)        match prop {
[625](#625)            Prop::Shorthand(ident) if ident.sym == key => {
[626](#626)                let prop = match props.remove(i) {
[627](#627)                    PropOrSpread::Prop(x) => *x,
[628](#628)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[629](#629)                };
[630](#630)                let ident = match prop {
[631](#631)                    Prop::Shorthand(x) => x,
[632](#632)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[633](#633)                };
[634](#634)                return Some(ident.into());
[635](#635)            }
[636](#636)
[637](#637)            Prop::KeyValue(prop) => {
[638](#638)                if key != "__proto__" && prop_name_eq(&prop.key, "__proto__") {
[639](#639)                    let Expr::Object(ObjectLit { props, .. }) = &mut *prop.value else {
[642](#642)                        return None;
[645](#645)                    };
[646](#646)
[647](#647)                    let v = get_key_value(key, props);
[651](#651)                    if v.is_some() {
[652](#652)                        return v;
[653](#653)                    }
[654](#654)                } else if prop_name_eq(&prop.key, key) {
[655](#655)                    let prop = match props.remove(i) {
[656](#656)                        PropOrSpread::Prop(x) => *x,
[657](#657)                        _ => unreachable!(),
[658](#658)                    };
[659](#659)                    let prop = match prop {
[660](#660)                        Prop::KeyValue(x) => x,
[661](#661)                        _ => unreachable!(),
[662](#662)                    };
[663](#663)                    return Some(prop.value);
[664](#664)                }
[665](#665)            }
[666](#666)
[667](#667)            _ => {}
[668](#668)        }
[669](#669)    }
[670](#670)
[671](#671)    None
[672](#672)}
[673](#673)
[674](#674)pub fn optimize_member_expr(
[676](#676)    expr_ctx: ExprCtx,
[677](#677)    expr: &mut Expr,
[678](#678)    is_callee: bool,
[679](#679)    changed: &mut bool,
[680](#680)) {
[681](#681)    let MemberExpr { obj, prop, .. } = match expr {
[682](#682)        Expr::Member(member) => member,
[683](#683)        _ => return,
[684](#684)    };
[685](#685)
[686](#686)    #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Debug)]
[687](#687)    enum KnownOp {
[688](#688)        Len,
[690](#690)
[691](#691)        Index(f64),
[701](#701)
[702](#702)        IndexStr(Atom),
[704](#704)    }
[705](#705)    let op = match prop {
[706](#706)        MemberProp::Ident(IdentName { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "length" && !obj.is_object() => {
[707](#707)            KnownOp::Len
[708](#708)        }
[709](#709)        MemberProp::Ident(IdentName { sym, .. }) => {
[710](#710)            if is_callee {
[711](#711)                return;
[712](#712)            }
[713](#713)
[714](#714)            KnownOp::IndexStr(sym.clone())
[715](#715)        }
[716](#716)        MemberProp::Computed(ComputedPropName { expr, .. }) => {
[717](#717)            if is_callee {
[718](#718)                return;
[719](#719)            }
[720](#720)
[721](#721)            if let Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value, .. })) = &**expr {
[722](#722)                KnownOp::Index(*value)
[724](#724)            } else if let Known(s) = expr.as_pure_string(expr_ctx) {
[725](#725)                if s == "length" && !obj.is_object() {
[726](#726)                    KnownOp::Len
[728](#728)                } else if let Ok(n) = s.parse::<f64>() {
[729](#729)                    KnownOp::Index(n)
[731](#731)                } else {
[732](#732)                    KnownOp::IndexStr(s.into())
[734](#734)                }
[735](#735)            } else {
[736](#736)                return;
[737](#737)            }
[738](#738)        }
[739](#739)        _ => return,
[740](#740)    };
[741](#741)
[742](#742)    match &mut **obj {
[749](#749)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str { value, span, .. })) => match op {
[750](#750)            KnownOp::Len => {
[755](#755)                *changed = true;
[756](#756)
[757](#757)                let Some(value) = value.as_str() else {
[758](#758)                    return;
[759](#759)                };
[760](#760)
[761](#761)                *expr = Lit::Num(Number {
[762](#762)                    value: value.chars().map(|c| c.len_utf16()).sum::<usize>() as _,
[763](#763)                    span: *span,
[764](#764)                    raw: None,
[765](#765)                })
[766](#766)                .into();
[767](#767)            }
[768](#768)
[769](#769)            KnownOp::Index(idx) => {
[771](#771)                if idx.fract() != 0.0 || idx < 0.0 || idx as usize >= value.len() {
[772](#772)                    return;
[775](#775)                }
[776](#776)
[777](#777)                let c = nth_char(value, idx as _);
[778](#778)                *changed = true;
[779](#779)
[780](#780)                let mut value = Wtf8Buf::with_capacity(2);
[782](#782)                value.push(c);
[783](#783)
[784](#784)                *expr = Lit::Str(Str {
[785](#785)                    raw: None,
[786](#786)                    value: value.into(),
[787](#787)                    span: *span,
[788](#788)                })
[789](#789)                .into()
[790](#790)            }
[791](#791)
[792](#792)            KnownOp::IndexStr(..) => {}
[796](#796)        },
[797](#797)
[798](#798)        Expr::Array(ArrayLit { elems, span }) => {
[802](#802)            let has_spread = elems.iter().any(|elem| {
[804](#804)                elem.as_ref()
[805](#805)                    .map(|elem| elem.spread.is_some())
[806](#806)                    .unwrap_or(false)
[807](#807)            });
[808](#808)
[809](#809)            if has_spread {
[810](#810)                return;
[811](#811)            }
[812](#812)
[813](#813)            match op {
[814](#814)                KnownOp::Len => {
[815](#815)                    let may_have_side_effects = elems
[817](#817)                        .iter()
[818](#818)                        .filter_map(|e| e.as_ref())
[819](#819)                        .any(|e| e.expr.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx));
[820](#820)
[821](#821)                    if may_have_side_effects {
[822](#822)                        return;
[823](#823)                    }
[824](#824)
[825](#825)                    *changed = true;
[827](#827)
[828](#828)                    *expr = Lit::Num(Number {
[829](#829)                        value: elems.len() as _,
[830](#830)                        span: *span,
[831](#831)                        raw: None,
[832](#832)                    })
[833](#833)                    .into();
[834](#834)                }
[835](#835)
[836](#836)                KnownOp::Index(idx) => {
[837](#837)                    if idx.fract() != 0.0 || idx < 0.0 || idx as usize >= elems.len() {
[840](#840)                        return;
[841](#841)                    }
[842](#842)
[843](#843)                    let after_has_side_effect =
[845](#845)                        elems
[846](#846)                            .iter()
[847](#847)                            .skip((idx as usize + 1) as _)
[848](#848)                            .any(|elem| match elem {
[849](#849)                                Some(elem) => elem.expr.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx),
[850](#850)                                None => false,
[851](#851)                            });
[852](#852)
[853](#853)                    if after_has_side_effect {
[854](#854)                        return;
[855](#855)                    }
[856](#856)
[857](#857)                    *changed = true;
[858](#858)
[859](#859)                    let before: Vec<Option<ExprOrSpread>> = elems.drain(..(idx as usize)).collect();
[861](#861)                    let mut iter = elems.take().into_iter();
[862](#862)                    let e = iter.next().flatten();
[864](#864)                    let after: Vec<Option<ExprOrSpread>> = iter.collect();
[866](#866)
[867](#867)                    let v = match e {
[869](#869)                        None => Expr::undefined(*span),
[870](#870)                        Some(e) => e.expr,
[871](#871)                    };
[872](#872)
[873](#873)                    let mut exprs = Vec::new();
[875](#875)
[876](#876)                    for elem in before.into_iter().flatten() {
[878](#878)                        expr_ctx.extract_side_effects_to(&mut exprs, *elem.expr);
[879](#879)                    }
[880](#880)
[881](#881)                    let val = v;
[883](#883)
[884](#884)                    for elem in after.into_iter().flatten() {
[886](#886)                        expr_ctx.extract_side_effects_to(&mut exprs, *elem.expr);
[887](#887)                    }
[888](#888)
[889](#889)                    if exprs.is_empty() && val.directness_matters() {
[895](#895)                        exprs.push(0.into());
[896](#896)                    }
[897](#897)
[898](#898)                    exprs.push(val);
[900](#900)                    *expr = *Expr::from_exprs(exprs);
[901](#901)                }
[902](#902)
[903](#903)                KnownOp::IndexStr(..) => {}
[905](#905)            }
[906](#906)        }
[907](#907)
[908](#908)        Expr::Object(ObjectLit { props, span }) => {
[912](#912)            let key = match op {
[914](#914)                KnownOp::Index(i) => Atom::from(i.to_string()),
[915](#915)                KnownOp::IndexStr(key) if key != *"yield" && is_literal(props) => key,
[916](#916)                _ => return,
[917](#917)            };
[918](#918)
[919](#919)            let Some(v) = get_key_value(&key, props) else {
[922](#922)                return;
[923](#923)            };
[924](#924)
[925](#925)            *changed = true;
[926](#926)
[927](#927)            *expr = *expr_ctx.preserve_effects(
[928](#928)                *span,
[929](#929)                v,
[930](#930)                once(
[931](#931)                    ObjectLit {
[932](#932)                        props: props.take(),
[933](#933)                        span: *span,
[934](#934)                    }
[935](#935)                    .into(),
[936](#936)                ),
[937](#937)            );
[938](#938)        }
[939](#939)
[940](#940)        _ => {}
[941](#941)    }
[942](#942)}
[943](#943)
[944](#944)pub fn optimize_bin_expr(expr_ctx: ExprCtx, expr: &mut Expr, changed: &mut bool) {
[946](#946)    let BinExpr {
[947](#947)        left,
[948](#948)        op,
[949](#949)        right,
[950](#950)        span,
[951](#951)    } = match expr {
[952](#952)        Expr::Bin(bin) => bin,
[953](#953)        _ => return,
[954](#954)    };
[955](#955)    let op = *op;
[956](#956)
[957](#957)    macro_rules! try_replace {
[958](#958)        ($v:expr) => {{
[959](#959)            match $v {
[960](#960)                Known(v) => {
[961](#961)                    *changed = true;
[963](#963)
[964](#964)                    *expr = *make_bool_expr(expr_ctx, *span, v, {
[965](#965)                        iter::once(left.take()).chain(iter::once(right.take()))
[966](#966)                    });
[967](#967)                    return;
[968](#968)                }
[969](#969)                _ => {}
[970](#970)            }
[971](#971)        }};
[972](#972)        (number, $v:expr) => {{
[973](#973)            match $v {
[974](#974)                Known(v) => {
[975](#975)                    *changed = true;
[976](#976)
[977](#977)                    let value_expr = if !v.is_nan() {
[978](#978)                        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number {
[979](#979)                            value: v,
[980](#980)                            span: *span,
[981](#981)                            raw: None,
[982](#982)                        }))
[983](#983)                    } else {
[984](#984)                        Expr::Ident(Ident::new(atom!("NaN"), *span, expr_ctx.unresolved_ctxt))
[985](#985)                    };
[986](#986)
[987](#987)                    *expr = *expr_ctx.preserve_effects(*span, value_expr.into(), {
[988](#988)                        iter::once(left.take()).chain(iter::once(right.take()))
[989](#989)                    });
[990](#990)                    return;
[991](#991)                }
[992](#992)                _ => {}
[993](#993)            }
[994](#994)        }};
[995](#995)    }
[996](#996)
[997](#997)    match op {
[998](#998)        op!(bin, "+") => {
[999](#999)            if let (Known(l), Known(r)) =
[1001](#1001)                (left.as_pure_wtf8(expr_ctx), right.as_pure_wtf8(expr_ctx))
[1002](#1002)            {
[1003](#1003)                if left.is_str() || left.is_array_lit() || right.is_str() || right.is_array_lit() {
[1004](#1004)                    let mut l = l.into_owned();
[1005](#1005)
[1006](#1006)                    l.push_wtf8(&r);
[1007](#1007)
[1008](#1008)                    *changed = true;
[1009](#1009)
[1010](#1010)                    *expr = Lit::Str(Str {
[1011](#1011)                        raw: None,
[1012](#1012)                        value: l.into(),
[1013](#1013)                        span: *span,
[1014](#1014)                    })
[1015](#1015)                    .into();
[1016](#1016)                    return;
[1017](#1017)                }
[1018](#1018)            }
[1019](#1019)
[1020](#1020)            match expr.get_type(expr_ctx) {
[1021](#1021)                Known(StringType) => match expr {
[1023](#1023)                    Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[1024](#1024)                        left, right, span, ..
[1025](#1025)                    }) => {
[1026](#1026)                        if !left.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx)
[1027](#1027)                            && !right.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx)
[1028](#1028)                        {
[1029](#1029)                            if let (Known(l), Known(r)) =
[1030](#1030)                                (left.as_pure_wtf8(expr_ctx), right.as_pure_wtf8(expr_ctx))
[1031](#1031)                            {
[1032](#1032)                                *changed = true;
[1033](#1033)
[1034](#1034)                                let mut value = l.into_owned();
[1035](#1035)                                value.push_wtf8(&r);
[1036](#1036)
[1037](#1037)                                *expr = Lit::Str(Str {
[1038](#1038)                                    raw: None,
[1039](#1039)                                    value: value.into(),
[1040](#1040)                                    span: *span,
[1041](#1041)                                })
[1042](#1042)                                .into();
[1043](#1043)                            }
[1044](#1044)                        }
[1045](#1045)                    }
[1046](#1046)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[1047](#1047)                },
[1048](#1048)                Known(BoolType) | Known(NullType) | Known(NumberType) | Known(UndefinedType) => {
[1050](#1050)                    match expr {
[1051](#1051)                        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[1052](#1052)                            left, right, span, ..
[1053](#1053)                        }) => {
[1054](#1054)                            if let Known(v) = perform_arithmetic_op(expr_ctx, op, left, right) {
[1055](#1055)                                *changed = true;
[1056](#1056)                                let span = *span;
[1057](#1057)
[1058](#1058)                                let value_expr = if !v.is_nan() {
[1059](#1059)                                    Lit::Num(Number {
[1060](#1060)                                        value: v,
[1061](#1061)                                        span,
[1062](#1062)                                        raw: None,
[1063](#1063)                                    })
[1064](#1064)                                    .into()
[1065](#1065)                                } else {
[1066](#1066)                                    Ident::new(atom!("NaN"), span, expr_ctx.unresolved_ctxt).into()
[1067](#1067)                                };
[1068](#1068)
[1069](#1069)                                *expr = *expr_ctx.preserve_effects(
[1070](#1070)                                    span,
[1071](#1071)                                    value_expr,
[1072](#1072)                                    iter::once(left.take()).chain(iter::once(right.take())),
[1073](#1073)                                );
[1074](#1074)                            }
[1075](#1075)                        }
[1076](#1076)                        _ => unreachable!(),
[1077](#1077)                    };
[1078](#1078)                }
[1079](#1079)                _ => {}
[1080](#1080)            }
[1081](#1081)
[1082](#1082)            }
[1084](#1084)
[1085](#1085)        op!("&&") | op!("||") => {
[1086](#1086)            if let (_, Known(val)) = left.cast_to_bool(expr_ctx) {
[1087](#1087)                let node = if op == op!("&&") {
[1088](#1088)                    if val {
[1089](#1089)                        right
[1091](#1091)                    } else {
[1092](#1092)                        *changed = true;
[1093](#1093)
[1094](#1094)                        *expr = *left.take();
[1096](#1096)                        return;
[1097](#1097)                    }
[1098](#1098)                } else if val {
[1099](#1099)                    *changed = true;
[1100](#1100)
[1101](#1101)                    *expr = *(left.take());
[1103](#1103)                    return;
[1104](#1104)                } else {
[1105](#1105)                    right
[1107](#1107)                };
[1108](#1108)
[1109](#1109)                if !left.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[1110](#1110)                    *changed = true;
[1111](#1111)
[1112](#1112)                    if node.directness_matters() {
[1113](#1113)                        *expr = SeqExpr {
[1114](#1114)                            span: node.span(),
[1115](#1115)                            exprs: vec![0.into(), node.take()],
[1116](#1116)                        }
[1117](#1117)                        .into();
[1118](#1118)                    } else {
[1119](#1119)                        *expr = *node.take();
[1120](#1120)                    }
[1121](#1121)                } else {
[1122](#1122)                    *changed = true;
[1123](#1123)
[1124](#1124)                    let seq = SeqExpr {
[1125](#1125)                        span: *span,
[1126](#1126)                        exprs: vec![left.take(), node.take()],
[1127](#1127)                    };
[1128](#1128)
[1129](#1129)                    *expr = seq.into()
[1130](#1130)                };
[1131](#1131)            }
[1132](#1132)        }
[1133](#1133)        op!("instanceof") => {
[1134](#1134)            fn is_non_obj(e: &Expr) -> bool {
[1135](#1135)                match e {
[1136](#1136)                    Expr::Lit(Lit::Str { .. })
[1138](#1138)                    | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[1139](#1139)                    | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..))
[1140](#1140)                    | Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(..)) => true,
[1141](#1141)                    Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "undefined" => true,
[1142](#1142)                    Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "Infinity" => true,
[1143](#1143)                    Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "NaN" => true,
[1144](#1144)
[1145](#1145)                    Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1146](#1146)                        op: op!("!"),
[1147](#1147)                        ref arg,
[1148](#1148)                        ..
[1149](#1149)                    })
[1150](#1150)                    | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1151](#1151)                        op: op!(unary, "-"),
[1152](#1152)                        ref arg,
[1153](#1153)                        ..
[1154](#1154)                    })
[1155](#1155)                    | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1156](#1156)                        op: op!("void"),
[1157](#1157)                        ref arg,
[1158](#1158)                        ..
[1159](#1159)                    }) => is_non_obj(arg),
[1160](#1160)                    _ => false,
[1161](#1161)                }
[1162](#1162)            }
[1163](#1163)
[1164](#1164)            fn is_obj(e: &Expr) -> bool {
[1165](#1165)                matches!(
[1166](#1166)                    *e,
[1167](#1167)                    Expr::Array { .. } | Expr::Object { .. } | Expr::Fn { .. } | Expr::New { .. }
[1168](#1168)                )
[1169](#1169)            }
[1170](#1170)
[1171](#1171)            if is_non_obj(left) {
[1173](#1173)                *changed = true;
[1174](#1174)
[1175](#1175)                *expr = *make_bool_expr(expr_ctx, *span, false, iter::once(right.take()));
[1176](#1176)                return;
[1177](#1177)            }
[1178](#1178)
[1179](#1179)            if is_obj(left) && right.is_global_ref_to(expr_ctx, "Object") {
[1180](#1180)                *changed = true;
[1181](#1181)
[1182](#1182)                *expr = *make_bool_expr(expr_ctx, *span, true, iter::once(left.take()));
[1183](#1183)            }
[1184](#1184)        }
[1185](#1185)
[1186](#1186)        op!(bin, "-") | op!("/") | op!("%") | op!("**") => {
[1188](#1188)            try_replace!(number, perform_arithmetic_op(expr_ctx, op, left, right))
[1189](#1189)        }
[1190](#1190)
[1191](#1191)        op!("<<") | op!(">>") | op!(">>>") => {
[1193](#1193)            fn try_fold_shift(ctx: ExprCtx, op: BinaryOp, left: &Expr, right: &Expr) -> Value<f64> {
[1194](#1194)                if !left.is_number() || !right.is_number() {
[1195](#1195)                    return Unknown;
[1196](#1196)                }
[1197](#1197)
[1198](#1198)                let (lv, rv) = match (left.as_pure_number(ctx), right.as_pure_number(ctx)) {
[1199](#1199)                    (Known(lv), Known(rv)) => (lv, rv),
[1200](#1200)                    _ => unreachable!(),
[1201](#1201)                };
[1202](#1202)                let (lv, rv) = (JsNumber::from(lv), JsNumber::from(rv));
[1203](#1203)
[1204](#1204)                Known(match op {
[1205](#1205)                    op!("<<") => *(lv << rv),
[1206](#1206)                    op!(">>") => *(lv >> rv),
[1207](#1207)                    op!(">>>") => *(lv.unsigned_shr(rv)),
[1208](#1208)
[1209](#1209)                    _ => unreachable!("Unknown bit operator {:?}", op),
[1210](#1210)                })
[1211](#1211)            }
[1212](#1212)            try_replace!(number, try_fold_shift(expr_ctx, op, left, right))
[1213](#1213)        }
[1214](#1214)
[1215](#1215)        op!("*") | op!("&") | op!("|") | op!("^") => {
[1219](#1219)            try_replace!(number, perform_arithmetic_op(expr_ctx, op, left, right));
[1220](#1220)
[1221](#1221)            if let Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[1223](#1223)                span: _,
[1224](#1224)                left: left_lhs,
[1225](#1225)                op: left_op,
[1226](#1226)                right: left_rhs,
[1227](#1227)            }) = &mut **left
[1228](#1228)            {
[1229](#1229)                if *left_op == op {
[1230](#1230)                    if let Known(value) = perform_arithmetic_op(expr_ctx, op, left_rhs, right) {
[1231](#1231)                        let value_expr = if !value.is_nan() {
[1232](#1232)                            Lit::Num(Number {
[1233](#1233)                                value,
[1234](#1234)                                span: *span,
[1235](#1235)                                raw: None,
[1236](#1236)                            })
[1237](#1237)                            .into()
[1238](#1238)                        } else {
[1239](#1239)                            Ident::new(atom!("NaN"), *span, expr_ctx.unresolved_ctxt).into()
[1240](#1240)                        };
[1241](#1241)
[1242](#1242)                        *changed = true;
[1243](#1243)                        *left = left_lhs.take();
[1244](#1244)                        *right = Box::new(value_expr);
[1245](#1245)                    }
[1246](#1246)                }
[1247](#1247)            }
[1248](#1248)        }
[1249](#1249)
[1250](#1250)        op!("<") => {
[1252](#1252)            try_replace!(perform_abstract_rel_cmp(expr_ctx, left, right, false))
[1253](#1253)        }
[1254](#1254)        op!(">") => {
[1255](#1255)            try_replace!(perform_abstract_rel_cmp(expr_ctx, right, left, false))
[1256](#1256)        }
[1257](#1257)        op!("<=") => {
[1258](#1258)            try_replace!(!perform_abstract_rel_cmp(expr_ctx, right, left, true))
[1259](#1259)        }
[1260](#1260)        op!(">=") => {
[1261](#1261)            try_replace!(!perform_abstract_rel_cmp(expr_ctx, left, right, true))
[1262](#1262)        }
[1263](#1263)
[1264](#1264)        op!("==") => try_replace!(perform_abstract_eq_cmp(expr_ctx, *span, left, right)),
[1265](#1265)        op!("!=") => try_replace!(!perform_abstract_eq_cmp(expr_ctx, *span, left, right)),
[1266](#1266)        op!("===") => try_replace!(perform_strict_eq_cmp(expr_ctx, left, right)),
[1267](#1267)        op!("!==") => try_replace!(!perform_strict_eq_cmp(expr_ctx, left, right)),
[1268](#1268)        _ => {}
[1269](#1269)    };
[1270](#1270)}
[1271](#1271)
[1272](#1272)pub fn optimize_unary_expr(expr_ctx: ExprCtx, expr: &mut Expr, changed: &mut bool) {
[1274](#1274)    let UnaryExpr { op, arg, span } = match expr {
[1275](#1275)        Expr::Unary(unary) => unary,
[1276](#1276)        _ => return,
[1277](#1277)    };
[1278](#1278)    let may_have_side_effects = arg.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx);
[1279](#1279)
[1280](#1280)    match op {
[1281](#1281)        op!("typeof") if !may_have_side_effects => {
[1282](#1282)            try_fold_typeof(expr_ctx, expr, changed);
[1283](#1283)        }
[1284](#1284)        op!("!") => {
[1285](#1285)            match &**arg {
[1286](#1286)                Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..)) => return,
[1288](#1288)
[1289](#1289)                Expr::Call(call) => {
[1291](#1291)                    if let Callee::Expr(callee) = &call.callee {
[1292](#1292)                        if let Expr::Fn(..) = &**callee {
[1293](#1293)                            return;
[1294](#1294)                        }
[1295](#1295)                    }
[1296](#1296)                }
[1297](#1297)                _ => {}
[1298](#1298)            }
[1299](#1299)
[1300](#1300)            if let (_, Known(val)) = arg.cast_to_bool(expr_ctx) {
[1301](#1301)                *changed = true;
[1302](#1302)
[1303](#1303)                *expr = *make_bool_expr(expr_ctx, *span, !val, iter::once(arg.take()));
[1304](#1304)            }
[1305](#1305)        }
[1306](#1306)        op!(unary, "+") => {
[1307](#1307)            if let Known(v) = arg.as_pure_number(expr_ctx) {
[1308](#1308)                *changed = true;
[1309](#1309)
[1310](#1310)                if v.is_nan() {
[1311](#1311)                    *expr = *expr_ctx.preserve_effects(
[1312](#1312)                        *span,
[1313](#1313)                        Ident::new(atom!("NaN"), *span, expr_ctx.unresolved_ctxt).into(),
[1314](#1314)                        iter::once(arg.take()),
[1315](#1315)                    );
[1316](#1316)                    return;
[1317](#1317)                }
[1318](#1318)
[1319](#1319)                *expr = *expr_ctx.preserve_effects(
[1320](#1320)                    *span,
[1321](#1321)                    Lit::Num(Number {
[1322](#1322)                        value: v,
[1323](#1323)                        span: *span,
[1324](#1324)                        raw: None,
[1325](#1325)                    })
[1326](#1326)                    .into(),
[1327](#1327)                    iter::once(arg.take()),
[1328](#1328)                );
[1329](#1329)            }
[1330](#1330)        }
[1331](#1331)        op!(unary, "-") => match &**arg {
[1332](#1332)            Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "Infinity" => {}
[1333](#1333)            Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "NaN" => {
[1335](#1335)                *changed = true;
[1336](#1336)                *expr = *(arg.take());
[1337](#1337)            }
[1338](#1338)            Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value: f, .. })) => {
[1339](#1339)                *changed = true;
[1340](#1340)                *expr = Lit::Num(Number {
[1341](#1341)                    value: -f,
[1342](#1342)                    span: *span,
[1343](#1343)                    raw: None,
[1344](#1344)                })
[1345](#1345)                .into();
[1346](#1346)            }
[1347](#1347)            _ => {
[1348](#1348)
[1349](#1349)                }
[1352](#1352)        },
[1353](#1353)        op!("void") if !may_have_side_effects => {
[1354](#1354)            match &**arg {
[1355](#1355)                Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value, .. })) if *value == 0.0 => return,
[1356](#1356)                _ => {}
[1357](#1357)            }
[1358](#1358)            *changed = true;
[1359](#1359)
[1360](#1360)            *arg = Lit::Num(Number {
[1361](#1361)                value: 0.0,
[1362](#1362)                span: arg.span(),
[1363](#1363)                raw: None,
[1364](#1364)            })
[1365](#1365)            .into();
[1366](#1366)        }
[1367](#1367)
[1368](#1368)        op!("~") => {
[1369](#1369)            if let Known(value) = arg.as_pure_number(expr_ctx) {
[1370](#1370)                if value.fract() == 0.0 {
[1371](#1371)                    *changed = true;
[1372](#1372)                    *expr = Lit::Num(Number {
[1373](#1373)                        span: *span,
[1374](#1374)                        value: if value < 0.0 {
[1375](#1375)                            !(value as i32 as u32) as i32 as f64
[1376](#1376)                        } else {
[1377](#1377)                            !(value as u32) as i32 as f64
[1378](#1378)                        },
[1379](#1379)                        raw: None,
[1380](#1380)                    })
[1381](#1381)                    .into();
[1382](#1382)                }
[1383](#1383)                }
[1385](#1385)        }
[1386](#1386)        _ => {}
[1387](#1387)    }
[1388](#1388)}
[1389](#1389)
[1390](#1390)fn try_fold_typeof(_expr_ctx: ExprCtx, expr: &mut Expr, changed: &mut bool) {
[1396](#1396)    let UnaryExpr { op, arg, span } = match expr {
[1397](#1397)        Expr::Unary(unary) => unary,
[1398](#1398)        _ => return,
[1399](#1399)    };
[1400](#1400)    assert_eq!(*op, op!("typeof"));
[1401](#1401)
[1402](#1402)    let val = match &**arg {
[1403](#1403)        Expr::Fn(..) => "function",
[1404](#1404)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str { .. }) => "string",
[1405](#1405)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..)) => "number",
[1406](#1406)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(..)) => "boolean",
[1407](#1407)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) | Expr::Object { .. } | Expr::Array { .. } => "object",
[1408](#1408)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1409](#1409)            op: op!("void"), ..
[1410](#1410)        }) => "undefined",
[1411](#1411)
[1412](#1412)        Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, .. }) if &**sym == "undefined" => {
[1413](#1413)            "undefined"
[1416](#1416)        }
[1417](#1417)
[1418](#1418)        _ => {
[1419](#1419)            return;
[1420](#1420)        }
[1421](#1421)    };
[1422](#1422)
[1423](#1423)    *changed = true;
[1424](#1424)
[1425](#1425)    *expr = Lit::Str(Str {
[1426](#1426)        span: *span,
[1427](#1427)        raw: None,
[1428](#1428)        value: val.into(),
[1429](#1429)    })
[1430](#1430)    .into();
[1431](#1431)}
[1432](#1432)
[1433](#1433)fn perform_arithmetic_op(expr_ctx: ExprCtx, op: BinaryOp, left: &Expr, right: &Expr) -> Value<f64> {
[1435](#1435)    macro_rules! try_replace {
[1437](#1437)        ($value:expr) => {{
[1438](#1438)            let (ls, rs) = (left.span(), right.span());
[1439](#1439)            if ls.is_dummy() || rs.is_dummy() {
[1440](#1440)                Known($value)
[1441](#1441)            } else {
[1442](#1442)                let new_len = format!("{}", $value).len();
[1443](#1443)                if right.span().hi() > left.span().lo() {
[1444](#1444)                    let orig_len =
[1445](#1445)                        right.span().hi() - right.span().lo() + left.span().hi() - left.span().lo();
[1446](#1446)                    if new_len <= orig_len.0 as usize + 1 {
[1447](#1447)                        Known($value)
[1448](#1448)                    } else {
[1449](#1449)                        Unknown
[1450](#1450)                    }
[1451](#1451)                } else {
[1452](#1452)                    Known($value)
[1453](#1453)                }
[1454](#1454)            }
[1455](#1455)        }};
[1456](#1456)        (i32, $value:expr) => {
[1457](#1457)            try_replace!($value as f64)
[1458](#1458)        };
[1459](#1459)    }
[1460](#1460)
[1461](#1461)    let (lv, rv) = (
[1462](#1462)        left.as_pure_number(expr_ctx),
[1463](#1463)        right.as_pure_number(expr_ctx),
[1464](#1464)    );
[1465](#1465)
[1466](#1466)    if (lv.is_unknown() && rv.is_unknown())
[1467](#1467)        || op == op!(bin, "+")
[1468](#1468)            && (!left.get_type(expr_ctx).casted_to_number_on_add()
[1469](#1469)                || !right.get_type(expr_ctx).casted_to_number_on_add())
[1470](#1470)    {
[1471](#1471)        return Unknown;
[1472](#1472)    }
[1473](#1473)
[1474](#1474)    match op {
[1475](#1475)        op!(bin, "+") => {
[1476](#1476)            if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (lv, rv) {
[1477](#1477)                return try_replace!(lv + rv);
[1478](#1478)            }
[1479](#1479)
[1480](#1480)            if lv == Known(0.0) {
[1481](#1481)                return rv;
[1482](#1482)            } else if rv == Known(0.0) {
[1483](#1483)                return lv;
[1484](#1484)            }
[1485](#1485)
[1486](#1486)            return Unknown;
[1487](#1487)        }
[1488](#1488)        op!(bin, "-") => {
[1489](#1489)            if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (lv, rv) {
[1490](#1490)                return try_replace!(lv - rv);
[1491](#1491)            }
[1492](#1492)
[1493](#1493)            if lv == Known(0.0) {
[1495](#1495)                return rv;
[1496](#1496)            }
[1497](#1497)
[1498](#1498)            if rv == Known(0.0) {
[1500](#1500)                return lv;
[1501](#1501)            }
[1502](#1502)
[1503](#1503)            return Unknown;
[1504](#1504)        }
[1505](#1505)        op!("*") => {
[1506](#1506)            if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (lv, rv) {
[1507](#1507)                return try_replace!(lv * rv);
[1508](#1508)            }
[1509](#1509)            if Known(1.0) == lv {
[1513](#1513)                return rv;
[1514](#1514)            }
[1515](#1515)            if Known(1.0) == rv {
[1516](#1516)                return lv;
[1517](#1517)            }
[1518](#1518)
[1519](#1519)            return Unknown;
[1520](#1520)        }
[1521](#1521)
[1522](#1522)        op!("/") => {
[1523](#1523)            if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (lv, rv) {
[1524](#1524)                if rv == 0.0 {
[1525](#1525)                    return Unknown;
[1526](#1526)                }
[1527](#1527)                return try_replace!(lv / rv);
[1528](#1528)            }
[1529](#1529)
[1530](#1530)            if rv == Known(1.0) {
[1533](#1533)                return lv;
[1536](#1536)            }
[1537](#1537)            return Unknown;
[1538](#1538)        }
[1539](#1539)
[1540](#1540)        op!("**") => {
[1541](#1541)            if Known(0.0) == rv {
[1542](#1542)                return Known(1.0);
[1543](#1543)            }
[1544](#1544)
[1545](#1545)            if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (lv, rv) {
[1546](#1546)                let lv: JsNumber = lv.into();
[1547](#1547)                let rv: JsNumber = rv.into();
[1548](#1548)                let result: f64 = lv.pow(rv).into();
[1549](#1549)                return try_replace!(result);
[1550](#1550)            }
[1551](#1551)
[1552](#1552)            return Unknown;
[1553](#1553)        }
[1554](#1554)        _ => {}
[1555](#1555)    }
[1556](#1556)    let (lv, rv) = match (lv, rv) {
[1557](#1557)        (Known(lv), Known(rv)) => (lv, rv),
[1558](#1558)        _ => return Unknown,
[1559](#1559)    };
[1560](#1560)
[1561](#1561)    match op {
[1562](#1562)        op!("&") => try_replace!(i32, to_int32(lv) & to_int32(rv)),
[1563](#1563)        op!("|") => try_replace!(i32, to_int32(lv) | to_int32(rv)),
[1564](#1564)        op!("^") => try_replace!(i32, to_int32(lv) ^ to_int32(rv)),
[1565](#1565)        op!("%") => {
[1566](#1566)            if rv == 0.0 {
[1567](#1567)                return Unknown;
[1568](#1568)            }
[1569](#1569)            try_replace!(lv % rv)
[1570](#1570)        }
[1571](#1571)        _ => unreachable!("unknown binary operator: {:?}", op),
[1572](#1572)    }
[1573](#1573)}
[1574](#1574)
[1575](#1575)fn perform_abstract_rel_cmp(
[1579](#1579)    expr_ctx: ExprCtx,
[1580](#1580)    left: &Expr,
[1581](#1581)    right: &Expr,
[1582](#1582)    will_negate: bool,
[1583](#1583)) -> Value<bool> {
[1584](#1584)    match (left, right) {
[1585](#1585)        (
[1587](#1587)            &Expr::Ident(
[1588](#1588)                Ident {
[1589](#1589)                    sym: ref li,
[1590](#1590)                    ctxt: l_ctxt,
[1591](#1591)                    ..
[1592](#1592)                },
[1593](#1593)                ..,
[1594](#1594)            ),
[1595](#1595)            &Expr::Ident(Ident {
[1596](#1596)                sym: ref ri,
[1597](#1597)                ctxt: r_ctxt,
[1598](#1598)                ..
[1599](#1599)            }),
[1600](#1600)        ) if !will_negate && li == ri && l_ctxt == r_ctxt => {
[1601](#1601)            return Known(false);
[1602](#1602)        }
[1603](#1603)        (
[1605](#1605)            &Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1606](#1606)                op: op!("typeof"),
[1607](#1607)                arg: ref la,
[1608](#1608)                ..
[1609](#1609)            }),
[1610](#1610)            &Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1611](#1611)                op: op!("typeof"),
[1612](#1612)                arg: ref ra,
[1613](#1613)                ..
[1614](#1614)            }),
[1615](#1615)        ) if la.as_ident().is_some()
[1616](#1616)            && la.as_ident().map(|i| i.to_id()) == ra.as_ident().map(|i| i.to_id()) =>
[1617](#1617)        {
[1618](#1618)            return Known(false)
[1619](#1619)        }
[1620](#1620)        _ => {}
[1621](#1621)    }
[1622](#1622)
[1623](#1623)    let (lt, rt) = (left.get_type(expr_ctx), right.get_type(expr_ctx));
[1625](#1625)
[1626](#1626)    if let (Known(StringType), Known(StringType)) = (lt, rt) {
[1627](#1627)        if let (Known(lv), Known(rv)) = (
[1628](#1628)            left.as_pure_string(expr_ctx),
[1629](#1629)            right.as_pure_string(expr_ctx),
[1630](#1630)        ) {
[1631](#1631)            if lv.contains('\u{000B}') || rv.contains('\u{000B}') {
[1634](#1634)                return Unknown;
[1635](#1635)            } else {
[1636](#1636)                return Known(lv < rv);
[1637](#1637)            }
[1638](#1638)        }
[1639](#1639)    }
[1640](#1640)
[1641](#1641)    let (lv, rv) = (
[1644](#1644)        try_val!(left.as_pure_number(expr_ctx)),
[1645](#1645)        try_val!(right.as_pure_number(expr_ctx)),
[1646](#1646)    );
[1647](#1647)    if lv.is_nan() || rv.is_nan() {
[1648](#1648)        return Known(will_negate);
[1649](#1649)    }
[1650](#1650)
[1651](#1651)    Known(lv < rv)
[1652](#1652)}
[1653](#1653)
[1654](#1654)fn perform_abstract_eq_cmp(
[1656](#1656)    expr_ctx: ExprCtx,
[1657](#1657)    span: Span,
[1658](#1658)    left: &Expr,
[1659](#1659)    right: &Expr,
[1660](#1660)) -> Value<bool> {
[1661](#1661)    let (lt, rt) = (
[1662](#1662)        try_val!(left.get_type(expr_ctx)),
[1663](#1663)        try_val!(right.get_type(expr_ctx)),
[1664](#1664)    );
[1665](#1665)
[1666](#1666)    if lt == rt {
[1667](#1667)        return perform_strict_eq_cmp(expr_ctx, left, right);
[1668](#1668)    }
[1669](#1669)
[1670](#1670)    match (lt, rt) {
[1671](#1671)        (NullType, UndefinedType) | (UndefinedType, NullType) => Known(true),
[1672](#1672)        (NumberType, StringType) | (_, BoolType) => {
[1673](#1673)            let rv = try_val!(right.as_pure_number(expr_ctx));
[1674](#1674)            perform_abstract_eq_cmp(
[1675](#1675)                expr_ctx,
[1676](#1676)                span,
[1677](#1677)                left,
[1678](#1678)                &Lit::Num(Number {
[1679](#1679)                    value: rv,
[1680](#1680)                    span,
[1681](#1681)                    raw: None,
[1682](#1682)                })
[1683](#1683)                .into(),
[1684](#1684)            )
[1685](#1685)        }
[1686](#1686)
[1687](#1687)        (StringType, NumberType) | (BoolType, _) => {
[1688](#1688)            let lv = try_val!(left.as_pure_number(expr_ctx));
[1689](#1689)            perform_abstract_eq_cmp(
[1690](#1690)                expr_ctx,
[1691](#1691)                span,
[1692](#1692)                &Lit::Num(Number {
[1693](#1693)                    value: lv,
[1694](#1694)                    span,
[1695](#1695)                    raw: None,
[1696](#1696)                })
[1697](#1697)                .into(),
[1698](#1698)                right,
[1699](#1699)            )
[1700](#1700)        }
[1701](#1701)
[1702](#1702)        (StringType, ObjectType)
[1703](#1703)        | (NumberType, ObjectType)
[1704](#1704)        | (ObjectType, StringType)
[1705](#1705)        | (ObjectType, NumberType) => Unknown,
[1706](#1706)
[1707](#1707)        _ => Known(false),
[1708](#1708)    }
[1709](#1709)}
[1710](#1710)
[1711](#1711)fn perform_strict_eq_cmp(expr_ctx: ExprCtx, left: &Expr, right: &Expr) -> Value<bool> {
[1713](#1713)    if left.is_nan() || right.is_nan() {
[1715](#1715)        return Known(false);
[1716](#1716)    }
[1717](#1717)    match (left, right) {
[1718](#1718)        (
[1720](#1720)            &Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1721](#1721)                op: op!("typeof"),
[1722](#1722)                arg: ref la,
[1723](#1723)                ..
[1724](#1724)            }),
[1725](#1725)            &Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1726](#1726)                op: op!("typeof"),
[1727](#1727)                arg: ref ra,
[1728](#1728)                ..
[1729](#1729)            }),
[1730](#1730)        ) if la.as_ident().is_some()
[1731](#1731)            && la.as_ident().map(|i| i.to_id()) == ra.as_ident().map(|i| i.to_id()) =>
[1732](#1732)        {
[1733](#1733)            return Known(true)
[1734](#1734)        }
[1735](#1735)        _ => {}
[1736](#1736)    }
[1737](#1737)
[1738](#1738)    let (lt, rt) = (
[1739](#1739)        try_val!(left.get_type(expr_ctx)),
[1740](#1740)        try_val!(right.get_type(expr_ctx)),
[1741](#1741)    );
[1742](#1742)    if lt != rt {
[1744](#1744)        return Known(false);
[1745](#1745)    }
[1746](#1746)
[1747](#1747)    match lt {
[1748](#1748)        UndefinedType | NullType => Known(true),
[1749](#1749)        NumberType => Known(
[1750](#1750)            try_val!(left.as_pure_number(expr_ctx)) == try_val!(right.as_pure_number(expr_ctx)),
[1751](#1751)        ),
[1752](#1752)        StringType => {
[1753](#1753)            let (lv, rv) = (
[1754](#1754)                try_val!(left.as_pure_string(expr_ctx)),
[1755](#1755)                try_val!(right.as_pure_string(expr_ctx)),
[1756](#1756)            );
[1757](#1757)            if lv.contains('\u{000B}') || rv.contains('\u{000B}') {
[1760](#1760)                return Unknown;
[1761](#1761)            }
[1762](#1762)            Known(lv == rv)
[1763](#1763)        }
[1764](#1764)        BoolType => {
[1765](#1765)            let (lv, rv) = (left.as_pure_bool(expr_ctx), right.as_pure_bool(expr_ctx));
[1766](#1766)
[1767](#1767)            lv.and(rv).or((!lv).and(!rv))
[1770](#1770)        }
[1771](#1771)        ObjectType | SymbolType => Unknown,
[1772](#1772)    }
[1773](#1773)}

---
