[105](#105)impl VisitMut for Inlining<'_> {
[106](#106)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[107](#107)
[108](#108)    fn visit_mut_arrow_expr(&mut self, node: &mut ArrowExpr) {
[109](#109)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Fn { named: false }, node)
[110](#110)    }
[111](#111)
[112](#112)    fn visit_mut_assign_expr(&mut self, e: &mut AssignExpr) {
[113](#113)        tracing::trace!("{:?}; Fold<AssignExpr>", self.phase);
[114](#114)        self.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::Assign;
[115](#115)
[116](#116)        match e.op {
[117](#117)            op!("=") => {
[118](#118)                let mut v = WriteVisitor {
[119](#119)                    scope: &mut self.scope,
[120](#120)                };
[121](#121)
[122](#122)                e.left.visit_with(&mut v);
[123](#123)                e.right.visit_with(&mut v);
[124](#124)
[125](#125)                match &mut e.left {
[126](#126)                    AssignTarget::Simple(left) => {
[127](#127)                        if let SimpleAssignTarget::Member(ref left) = &*left {
[129](#129)                            tracing::trace!("Assign to member expression!");
[130](#130)                            let mut v = IdentListVisitor {
[131](#131)                                scope: &mut self.scope,
[132](#132)                            };
[133](#133)
[134](#134)                            left.visit_with(&mut v);
[135](#135)                            e.right.visit_with(&mut v);
[136](#136)                        }
[137](#137)                    }
[138](#138)                    AssignTarget::Pat(p) => {
[139](#139)                        p.visit_mut_with(self);
[140](#140)                    }
[141](#141)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[142](#142)                    _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[143](#143)                }
[144](#144)            }
[145](#145)
[146](#146)            _ => {
[147](#147)                let mut v = IdentListVisitor {
[148](#148)                    scope: &mut self.scope,
[149](#149)                };
[150](#150)
[151](#151)                e.left.visit_with(&mut v);
[152](#152)                e.right.visit_with(&mut v)
[153](#153)            }
[154](#154)        }
[155](#155)
[156](#156)        e.right.visit_mut_with(self);
[157](#157)
[158](#158)        if self.scope.is_inline_prevented(&e.right) {
[159](#159)            let ids: Vec<Id> = find_pat_ids(&e.left);
[161](#161)            for id in ids {
[162](#162)                self.scope.prevent_inline(&id);
[163](#163)            }
[164](#164)            return;
[165](#165)        }
[166](#166)
[167](#167)        if let Some(i) = e.left.as_ident() {
[169](#169)            let id = i.to_id();
[170](#170)            self.scope.add_write(&id, false);
[171](#171)
[172](#172)            if let Some(var) = self.scope.find_binding(&id) {
[173](#173)                if !var.is_inline_prevented() {
[174](#174)                    match *e.right {
[175](#175)                        Expr::Lit(..) | Expr::Ident(..) => {
[176](#176)                            *var.value.borrow_mut() = Some(*e.right.clone());
[177](#177)                        }
[178](#178)
[179](#179)                        _ => {
[180](#180)                            *var.value.borrow_mut() = None;
[181](#181)                        }
[182](#182)                    }
[183](#183)                }
[184](#184)            }
[185](#185)        }
[186](#186)    }
[187](#187)
[188](#188)    fn visit_mut_block_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut BlockStmt) {
[189](#189)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Block, node)
[190](#190)    }
[191](#191)
[192](#192)    fn visit_mut_call_expr(&mut self, node: &mut CallExpr) {
[193](#193)        node.callee.visit_mut_with(self);
[194](#194)
[195](#195)        if self.phase == Phase::Analysis {
[196](#196)            if let Callee::Expr(ref callee) = node.callee {
[197](#197)                self.scope.mark_this_sensitive(callee);
[198](#198)            }
[199](#199)        }
[200](#200)
[201](#201)        node.args.visit_children_with(&mut WriteVisitor {
[203](#203)            scope: &mut self.scope,
[204](#204)        });
[205](#205)
[206](#206)        node.args.visit_mut_with(self);
[207](#207)
[208](#208)        self.scope.store_inline_barrier(self.phase);
[209](#209)    }
[210](#210)
[211](#211)    fn visit_mut_catch_clause(&mut self, node: &mut CatchClause) {
[212](#212)        self.with_child(ScopeKind::Block, move |child| {
[213](#213)            child.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::CatchParam;
[214](#214)            node.param.visit_mut_with(child);
[215](#215)            match child.phase {
[216](#216)                Phase::Analysis => {
[217](#217)                    let ids: Vec<Id> = find_pat_ids(&node.param);
[218](#218)                    for id in ids {
[219](#219)                        child.scope.prevent_inline(&id);
[220](#220)                    }
[221](#221)                }
[222](#222)                Phase::Inlining => {}
[223](#223)            }
[224](#224)
[225](#225)            node.body.visit_mut_with(child);
[226](#226)        })
[227](#227)    }
[228](#228)
[229](#229)    fn visit_mut_do_while_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut DoWhileStmt) {
[230](#230)        {
[231](#231)            node.test.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[232](#232)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[233](#233)            });
[234](#234)        }
[235](#235)
[236](#236)        node.test.visit_mut_with(self);
[237](#237)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Loop, &mut node.body);
[238](#238)    }
[239](#239)
[240](#240)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, node: &mut Expr) {
[241](#241)        node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[242](#242)
[243](#243)        if self.phase == Phase::Inlining {
[257](#257)            if let Expr::Assign(e @ AssignExpr { op: op!("="), .. }) = node {
[258](#258)                if let Some(i) = e.left.as_ident() {
[259](#259)                    if let Some(var) = self.scope.find_binding_from_current(&i.to_id()) {
[260](#260)                        if var.is_undefined.get()
[261](#261)                            && !var.is_inline_prevented()
[262](#262)                            && !self.scope.is_inline_prevented(&e.right)
[263](#263)                        {
[264](#264)                            *var.value.borrow_mut() = Some(*e.right.clone());
[265](#265)                            var.is_undefined.set(false);
[266](#266)                            *node = *e.right.take();
[267](#267)                            return;
[268](#268)                        }
[269](#269)                    }
[270](#270)                }
[271](#271)
[272](#272)                return;
[273](#273)            }
[274](#274)        }
[275](#275)
[276](#276)        if let Expr::Ident(ref i) = node {
[277](#277)            let id = i.to_id();
[278](#278)            if self.is_first_run {
[279](#279)                if let Some(expr) = self.scope.find_constant(&id) {
[280](#280)                    self.changed = true;
[281](#281)                    let mut expr = expr.clone();
[282](#282)                    expr.visit_mut_with(self);
[283](#283)                    *node = expr;
[284](#284)                    return;
[285](#285)                }
[286](#286)            }
[287](#287)
[288](#288)            match self.phase {
[289](#289)                Phase::Analysis => {
[290](#290)                    if self.in_test {
[291](#291)                        if let Some(var) = self.scope.find_binding(&id) {
[292](#292)                            match &*var.value.borrow() {
[293](#293)                                Some(Expr::Ident(..)) | Some(Expr::Lit(..)) => {}
[294](#294)                                _ => {
[295](#295)                                    self.scope.prevent_inline(&id);
[296](#296)                                }
[297](#297)                            }
[298](#298)                        }
[299](#299)                    }
[300](#300)                    self.scope.add_read(&id);
[301](#301)                }
[302](#302)                Phase::Inlining => {
[303](#303)                    tracing::trace!("Trying to inline: {:?}", id);
[304](#304)                    let expr = if let Some(var) = self.scope.find_binding(&id) {
[305](#305)                        tracing::trace!("VarInfo: {:?}", var);
[306](#306)                        if !var.is_inline_prevented() {
[307](#307)                            let expr = var.value.borrow();
[308](#308)
[309](#309)                            if let Some(expr) = &*expr {
[310](#310)                                tracing::debug!("Inlining: {:?}", id);
[311](#311)
[312](#312)                                if *node != *expr {
[313](#313)                                    self.changed = true;
[314](#314)                                }
[315](#315)
[316](#316)                                Some(expr.clone())
[317](#317)                            } else {
[318](#318)                                tracing::debug!("Inlining: {:?} as undefined", id);
[319](#319)
[320](#320)                                if var.is_undefined.get() {
[321](#321)                                    *node = *Expr::undefined(i.span);
[322](#322)                                    return;
[323](#323)                                } else {
[324](#324)                                    tracing::trace!("Not a cheap expression");
[325](#325)                                    None
[326](#326)                                }
[327](#327)                            }
[328](#328)                        } else {
[329](#329)                            tracing::trace!("Inlining is prevented");
[330](#330)                            None
[331](#331)                        }
[332](#332)                    } else {
[333](#333)                        None
[334](#334)                    };
[335](#335)
[336](#336)                    if let Some(expr) = expr {
[337](#337)                        *node = expr;
[338](#338)                    }
[339](#339)                }
[340](#340)            }
[341](#341)        }
[342](#342)
[343](#343)        if let Expr::Bin(b) = node {
[344](#344)            match b.op {
[345](#345)                BinaryOp::LogicalAnd | BinaryOp::LogicalOr => {
[346](#346)                    self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Cond, &mut b.right);
[347](#347)                }
[348](#348)                _ => {}
[349](#349)            }
[350](#350)        }
[351](#351)    }
[352](#352)
[353](#353)    fn visit_mut_fn_decl(&mut self, node: &mut FnDecl) {
[354](#354)        if self.phase == Phase::Analysis {
[355](#355)            self.declare(
[356](#356)                node.ident.to_id(),
[357](#357)                None,
[358](#358)                true,
[359](#359)                VarType::Var(VarDeclKind::Var),
[360](#360)            );
[361](#361)        }
[362](#362)
[363](#363)        self.with_child(ScopeKind::Fn { named: true }, |child| {
[364](#364)            child.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::Param;
[365](#365)            node.function.params.visit_mut_with(child);
[366](#366)            match &mut node.function.body {
[367](#367)                None => {}
[368](#368)                Some(v) => {
[369](#369)                    v.visit_mut_children_with(child);
[370](#370)                }
[371](#371)            };
[372](#372)        });
[373](#373)    }
[374](#374)
[375](#375)    fn visit_mut_fn_expr(&mut self, node: &mut FnExpr) {
[376](#376)        if let Some(ref ident) = node.ident {
[377](#377)            self.scope.add_write(&ident.to_id(), true);
[378](#378)        }
[379](#379)
[380](#380)        node.function.visit_mut_with(self)
[381](#381)    }
[382](#382)
[383](#383)    fn visit_mut_for_in_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut ForInStmt) {
[384](#384)        self.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::Param;
[385](#385)        node.left.visit_mut_with(self);
[386](#386)
[387](#387)        {
[388](#388)            node.left.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[389](#389)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[390](#390)            });
[391](#391)        }
[392](#392)
[393](#393)        {
[394](#394)            node.right.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[395](#395)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[396](#396)            });
[397](#397)        }
[398](#398)
[399](#399)        node.right.visit_mut_with(self);
[400](#400)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Loop, &mut node.body);
[401](#401)    }
[402](#402)
[403](#403)    fn visit_mut_for_of_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut ForOfStmt) {
[404](#404)        self.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::Param;
[405](#405)        node.left.visit_mut_with(self);
[406](#406)
[407](#407)        {
[408](#408)            node.left.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[409](#409)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[410](#410)            });
[411](#411)        }
[412](#412)        {
[413](#413)            node.right.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[414](#414)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[415](#415)            });
[416](#416)        }
[417](#417)
[418](#418)        node.right.visit_mut_with(self);
[419](#419)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Loop, &mut node.body);
[420](#420)    }
[421](#421)
[422](#422)    fn visit_mut_for_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut ForStmt) {
[423](#423)        {
[424](#424)            node.init.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[425](#425)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[426](#426)            });
[427](#427)        }
[428](#428)        {
[429](#429)            node.test.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[430](#430)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[431](#431)            });
[432](#432)        }
[433](#433)        {
[434](#434)            node.update.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[435](#435)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[436](#436)            });
[437](#437)        }
[438](#438)
[439](#439)        node.init.visit_mut_with(self);
[440](#440)        node.test.visit_mut_with(self);
[441](#441)        node.update.visit_mut_with(self);
[442](#442)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Loop, &mut node.body);
[443](#443)
[444](#444)        if node.init.is_none() && node.test.is_none() && node.update.is_none() {
[445](#445)            self.scope.store_inline_barrier(self.phase);
[446](#446)        }
[447](#447)    }
[448](#448)
[449](#449)    fn visit_mut_function(&mut self, node: &mut Function) {
[450](#450)        self.with_child(ScopeKind::Fn { named: false }, move |child| {
[451](#451)            child.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::Param;
[452](#452)            node.params.visit_mut_with(child);
[453](#453)            match &mut node.body {
[454](#454)                None => None,
[455](#455)                Some(v) => {
[456](#456)                    v.visit_mut_children_with(child);
[457](#457)                    Some(())
[458](#458)                }
[459](#459)            };
[460](#460)        })
[461](#461)    }
[462](#462)
[463](#463)    fn visit_mut_if_stmt(&mut self, stmt: &mut IfStmt) {
[464](#464)        let old_in_test = self.in_test;
[465](#465)        self.in_test = true;
[466](#466)        stmt.test.visit_mut_with(self);
[467](#467)        self.in_test = old_in_test;
[468](#468)
[469](#469)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Cond, &mut stmt.cons);
[470](#470)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Cond, &mut stmt.alt);
[471](#471)    }
[472](#472)
[473](#473)    fn visit_mut_program(&mut self, program: &mut Program) {
[474](#474)        let _tracing = span!(Level::ERROR, "inlining", pass = self.pass).entered();
[475](#475)
[476](#476)        let old_phase = self.phase;
[477](#477)
[478](#478)        self.phase = Phase::Analysis;
[479](#479)        program.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[480](#480)
[481](#481)        tracing::trace!("Switching to Inlining phase");
[482](#482)
[483](#483)        self.phase = Phase::Inlining;
[485](#485)        program.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[486](#486)
[487](#487)        self.phase = old_phase;
[488](#488)    }
[489](#489)
[490](#490)    fn visit_mut_new_expr(&mut self, node: &mut NewExpr) {
[491](#491)        node.callee.visit_mut_with(self);
[492](#492)        if self.phase == Phase::Analysis {
[493](#493)            self.scope.mark_this_sensitive(&node.callee);
[494](#494)        }
[495](#495)
[496](#496)        node.args.visit_mut_with(self);
[497](#497)
[498](#498)        self.scope.store_inline_barrier(self.phase);
[499](#499)    }
[500](#500)
[501](#501)    fn visit_mut_pat(&mut self, node: &mut Pat) {
[502](#502)        node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[503](#503)
[504](#504)        if let Pat::Ident(ref i) = node {
[505](#505)            match self.pat_mode {
[506](#506)                PatFoldingMode::Param => {
[507](#507)                    self.declare(
[508](#508)                        i.to_id(),
[509](#509)                        Some(Cow::Owned(Ident::from(i).into())),
[510](#510)                        false,
[511](#511)                        VarType::Param,
[512](#512)                    );
[513](#513)                }
[514](#514)                PatFoldingMode::CatchParam => {
[515](#515)                    self.declare(
[516](#516)                        i.to_id(),
[517](#517)                        Some(Cow::Owned(Ident::from(i).into())),
[518](#518)                        false,
[519](#519)                        VarType::Var(VarDeclKind::Var),
[520](#520)                    );
[521](#521)                }
[522](#522)                PatFoldingMode::VarDecl => {}
[523](#523)                PatFoldingMode::Assign => {
[524](#524)                    if self.scope.find_binding_from_current(&i.to_id()).is_some() {
[525](#525)                    } else {
[526](#526)                        self.scope.add_write(&i.to_id(), false);
[527](#527)                    }
[528](#528)                }
[529](#529)            }
[530](#530)        }
[531](#531)    }
[532](#532)
[533](#533)    fn visit_mut_stmts(&mut self, items: &mut Vec<Stmt>) {
[534](#534)        let old_phase = self.phase;
[535](#535)
[536](#536)        match old_phase {
[537](#537)            Phase::Analysis => {
[538](#538)                items.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[539](#539)            }
[540](#540)            Phase::Inlining => {
[541](#541)                self.phase = Phase::Analysis;
[542](#542)                items.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[543](#543)
[544](#544)                self.phase = Phase::Inlining;
[546](#546)                items.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[547](#547)
[548](#548)                self.phase = old_phase
[549](#549)            }
[550](#550)        }
[551](#551)    }
[552](#552)
[553](#553)    fn visit_mut_switch_case(&mut self, node: &mut SwitchCase) {
[554](#554)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Block, node)
[555](#555)    }
[556](#556)
[557](#557)    fn visit_mut_try_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut TryStmt) {

[565](#565)    fn visit_mut_unary_expr(&mut self, node: &mut UnaryExpr) {

[586](#586)    fn visit_mut_var_decl(&mut self, decl: &mut VarDecl) {
[587](#587)        self.var_decl_kind = decl.kind;
[588](#588)
[589](#589)        decl.visit_mut_children_with(self)
[590](#590)    }
[591](#591)
[592](#592)    fn visit_mut_var_declarator(&mut self, node: &mut VarDeclarator) {
[593](#593)        let kind = VarType::Var(self.var_decl_kind);
[594](#594)        node.init.visit_mut_with(self);
[595](#595)
[596](#596)        self.pat_mode = PatFoldingMode::VarDecl;
[597](#597)
[598](#598)        match self.phase {
[599](#599)            Phase::Analysis => {
[600](#600)                if let Pat::Ident(ref name) = node.name {
[601](#601)                    match &node.init {
[603](#603)                        None => {
[604](#604)                            if self.var_decl_kind != VarDeclKind::Const {
[605](#605)                                self.declare(name.to_id(), None, true, kind);
[606](#606)                            }
[607](#607)                        }
[608](#608)
[609](#609)                        Some(e)
[611](#611)                            if (e.is_lit() || e.is_ident())
[612](#612)                                && self.var_decl_kind == VarDeclKind::Const =>
[613](#613)                        {
[614](#614)                            if self.is_first_run {
[615](#615)                                self.scope
[616](#616)                                    .constants
[617](#617)                                    .insert(name.to_id(), Some((**e).clone()));
[618](#618)                            }
[619](#619)                        }
[620](#620)                        Some(..) if self.var_decl_kind == VarDeclKind::Const => {
[621](#621)                            if self.is_first_run {
[622](#622)                                self.scope.constants.insert(name.to_id(), None);
[623](#623)                            }
[624](#624)                        }
[625](#625)
[626](#626)                        Some(e) | Some(e) if e.is_lit() || e.is_ident() => {
[628](#628)                            self.declare(name.to_id(), Some(Cow::Borrowed(e)), false, kind);
[629](#629)
[630](#630)                            if self.scope.is_inline_prevented(e) {
[631](#631)                                self.scope.prevent_inline(&name.to_id());
[632](#632)                            }
[633](#633)                        }
[634](#634)                        Some(ref e) => {
[635](#635)                            if self.var_decl_kind != VarDeclKind::Const {
[636](#636)                                self.declare(name.to_id(), Some(Cow::Borrowed(e)), false, kind);
[637](#637)
[638](#638)                                if contains_this_expr(&node.init) {
[639](#639)                                    self.scope.prevent_inline(&name.to_id());
[640](#640)                                    return;
[641](#641)                                }
[642](#642)                            }
[643](#643)                        }
[644](#644)                    }
[645](#645)                }
[646](#646)            }
[647](#647)            Phase::Inlining => {
[648](#648)                if let Pat::Ident(ref name) = node.name {
[649](#649)                    if self.var_decl_kind != VarDeclKind::Const {
[650](#650)                        let id = name.to_id();
[651](#651)
[652](#652)                        tracing::trace!("Trying to optimize variable declaration: {:?}", id);
[653](#653)
[654](#654)                        if self.scope.is_inline_prevented(&Ident::from(name).into())
[655](#655)                            || !self.scope.has_same_this(&id, node.init.as_deref())
[656](#656)                        {
[657](#657)                            tracing::trace!("Inline is prevented for {:?}", id);
[658](#658)                            return;
[659](#659)                        }
[660](#660)
[661](#661)                        let mut init = node.init.take();
[662](#662)                        init.visit_mut_with(self);
[663](#663)                        tracing::trace!("\tInit: {:?}", init);
[664](#664)
[665](#665)                        if let Some(init) = &init {
[666](#666)                            if let Expr::Ident(ri) = &**init {
[667](#667)                                self.declare(
[668](#668)                                    name.to_id(),
[669](#669)                                    Some(Cow::Owned(ri.clone().into())),
[670](#670)                                    false,
[671](#671)                                    kind,
[672](#672)                                );
[673](#673)                            }
[674](#674)                        }
[675](#675)
[676](#676)                        if let Some(ref e) = init {
[677](#677)                            if self.scope.is_inline_prevented(e) {
[678](#678)                                tracing::trace!(
[679](#679)                                    "Inlining is not possible as inline of the initialization was \
[680](#680)                                     prevented"
[681](#681)                                );
[682](#682)                                node.init = init;
[683](#683)                                self.scope.prevent_inline(&name.to_id());
[684](#684)                                return;
[685](#685)                            }
[686](#686)                        }
[687](#687)
[688](#688)                        let e = match init {
[689](#689)                            None => None,
[690](#690)                            Some(e) if e.is_lit() || e.is_ident() => Some(e),
[691](#691)                            Some(e) => {
[692](#692)                                let e = *e;
[693](#693)                                if self.scope.is_inline_prevented(&Ident::from(name).into()) {
[694](#694)                                    node.init = Some(Box::new(e));
[695](#695)                                    return;
[696](#696)                                }
[697](#697)
[698](#698)                                if let Some(cnt) = self.scope.read_cnt(&name.to_id()) {
[699](#699)                                    if cnt == 1 {
[700](#700)                                        Some(Box::new(e))
[701](#701)                                    } else {
[702](#702)                                        node.init = Some(Box::new(e));
[703](#703)                                        return;
[704](#704)                                    }
[705](#705)                                } else {
[706](#706)                                    node.init = Some(Box::new(e));
[707](#707)                                    return;
[708](#708)                                }
[709](#709)                            }
[710](#710)                        };
[711](#711)
[712](#712)                        self.declare(name.to_id(), e.map(|e| Cow::Owned(*e)), false, kind);
[716](#716)
[717](#717)                        return;
[718](#718)                    }
[719](#719)                }
[720](#720)            }
[721](#721)        }
[722](#722)
[723](#723)        node.name.visit_mut_with(self);
[724](#724)    }
[725](#725)
[726](#726)    fn visit_mut_while_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut WhileStmt) {
[727](#727)        {
[728](#728)            node.test.visit_with(&mut IdentListVisitor {
[729](#729)                scope: &mut self.scope,
[730](#730)            });
[731](#731)        }
[732](#732)
[733](#733)        node.test.visit_mut_with(self);
[734](#734)        self.visit_with_child(ScopeKind::Loop, &mut node.body);
[735](#735)    }
[736](#736)}
[737](#737)

[741](#741)}

[8](#8)pub fn constant_propagation() -> impl 'static + Pass + VisitMut {
[10](#10)    visit_mut_pass(ConstPropagation::default())
[11](#11)}
[12](#12)
[13](#13)#[derive(Default)]
[14](#14)struct ConstPropagation<'a> {
[15](#15)    scope: Scope<'a>,
[16](#16)}
[17](#17)#[derive(Default)]
[18](#18)struct Scope<'a> {
[19](#19)    parent: Option<&'a Scope<'a>>,
[20](#20)    vars: FxHashMap<Id, Box<Expr>>,
[22](#22)}
[23](#23)
[24](#24)impl<'a> Scope<'a> {
[25](#25)    fn new(parent: &'a Scope<'a>) -> Self {
[26](#26)        Self {
[27](#27)            parent: Some(parent),
[28](#28)            vars: Default::default(),
[29](#29)        }
[30](#30)    }
[31](#31)
[32](#32)    fn find_var(&self, id: &Id) -> Option<&Box<Expr>> {
[33](#33)        if let Some(v) = self.vars.get(id) {
[34](#34)            return Some(v);
[35](#35)        }
[36](#36)
[37](#37)        self.parent.and_then(|parent| parent.find_var(id))
[38](#38)    }
[39](#39)}
[40](#40)
[41](#41)impl VisitMut for ConstPropagation<'_> {
[42](#42)    noop_visit_mut_type!(fail);
[43](#43)
[44](#44)    fn visit_mut_assign_expr(&mut self, _: &mut AssignExpr) {}
[46](#46)
[47](#47)    fn visit_mut_export_named_specifier(&mut self, n: &mut ExportNamedSpecifier) {
[48](#48)        let id = match &n.orig {
[49](#49)            ModuleExportName::Ident(ident) => ident.to_id(),
[50](#50)            ModuleExportName::Str(..) => return,
[51](#51)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[52](#52)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[53](#53)        };
[54](#54)        if let Some(expr) = self.scope.find_var(&id) {
[55](#55)            if let Expr::Ident(v) = &**expr {
[56](#56)                let orig = n.orig.clone();
[57](#57)                n.orig = ModuleExportName::Ident(v.clone());
[58](#58)
[59](#59)                if n.exported.is_none() {
[60](#60)                    n.exported = Some(orig);
[61](#61)                }
[62](#62)            }
[63](#63)        }
[64](#64)
[65](#65)        match &n.exported {
[66](#66)            Some(ModuleExportName::Ident(exported)) => match &n.orig {
[67](#67)                ModuleExportName::Ident(orig) => {
[68](#68)                    if exported.sym == orig.sym && exported.ctxt == orig.ctxt {
[69](#69)                        n.exported = None;
[70](#70)                    }
[71](#71)                }
[72](#72)                ModuleExportName::Str(..) => {}
[73](#73)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[74](#74)                _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[75](#75)            },
[76](#76)            Some(ModuleExportName::Str(..)) => {}
[77](#77)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[78](#78)            Some(_) => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[79](#79)            None => {}
[80](#80)        }
[81](#81)    }
[82](#82)
[83](#83)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, e: &mut Expr) {
[84](#84)        if let Expr::Ident(i) = e {
[85](#85)            if let Some(expr) = self.scope.find_var(&i.to_id()) {
[86](#86)                *e = *expr.clone();
[87](#87)                return;
[88](#88)            }
[89](#89)        }
[90](#90)
[91](#91)        e.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[92](#92)    }
[93](#93)
[94](#94)    fn visit_mut_function(&mut self, n: &mut Function) {
[101](#101)        let scope = Scope::new(&self.scope);
[102](#102)        let mut v = ConstPropagation { scope };
[103](#103)        n.visit_mut_children_with(&mut v);
[104](#104)    }
[105](#105)
[106](#106)    fn visit_mut_prop(&mut self, p: &mut Prop) {
[107](#107)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[108](#108)
[109](#109)        if let Prop::Shorthand(i) = p {
[110](#110)            if let Some(expr) = self.scope.find_var(&i.to_id()) {
[111](#111)                *p = Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[112](#112)                    key: PropName::Ident(i.take().into()),
[113](#113)                    value: expr.clone(),
[114](#114)                });
[115](#115)            }
[116](#116)        }
[117](#117)    }
[118](#118)
[119](#119)    fn visit_mut_var_decl(&mut self, var: &mut VarDecl) {
[120](#120)        var.decls.visit_mut_with(self);
[121](#121)
[122](#122)        if let VarDeclKind::Const = var.kind {
[123](#123)            for decl in &var.decls {
[124](#124)                if let Pat::Ident(name) = &decl.name {
[125](#125)                    if let Some(init) = &decl.init {
[126](#126)                        match &**init {
[127](#127)                            Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(..))
[128](#128)                            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[129](#129)                            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => {
[130](#130)                                self.scope.vars.insert(name.to_id(), init.clone());
[131](#131)                            }
[132](#132)
[133](#133)                            Expr::Ident(init)
[134](#134)                                if name.span.is_dummy()
[135](#135)                                    || var.span.is_dummy()
[136](#136)                                    || init.span.is_dummy() =>
[137](#137)                            {
[138](#138)                                if let Some(value) = self.scope.vars.get(&init.to_id()).cloned() {
[140](#140)                                    self.scope.vars.insert(name.to_id(), value);
[141](#141)                                } else {
[142](#142)                                    self.scope.vars.insert(name.to_id(), init.clone().into());
[143](#143)                                }
[144](#144)                            }
[145](#145)                            _ => {}
[146](#146)                        }
[147](#147)                    }
[148](#148)                }
[149](#149)            }
[150](#150)        }
[151](#151)    }
[152](#152)}

[56](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#56)#[derive(Debug)]
[57](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#57)struct Remover {
[58](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#58)    changed: bool,
[59](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#59)    normal_block: bool,
[60](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#60)
[61](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#61)    expr_ctx: ExprCtx,
[62](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#62)}

[66](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#66)        Self { ..*self }
[67](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#67)    }

[70](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#70)}
[71](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#71)
[72](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#72)impl VisitMut for Remover {
[73](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#73)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[74](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#74)
[75](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#75)    fn visit_mut_class_members(&mut self, members: &mut Vec<ClassMember>) {
[76](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#76)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count(), members, |v, member| {
[77](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#77)            member.visit_mut_with(v);
[78](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#78)        });
[79](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#79)    }
[80](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#80)
[81](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#81)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, e: &mut Expr) {
[82](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#82)        e.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[83](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#83)
[84](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#84)        match e {
[85](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#85)            Expr::Seq(s) => {
[86](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#86)                if s.exprs.is_empty() {
[87](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#87)                    *e = Expr::dummy();
[88](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#88)                } else if s.exprs.len() == 1 {
[89](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#89)                    *e = *s.exprs.pop().unwrap();
[90](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#90)                }
[91](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#91)            }
[92](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#92)
[93](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#93)            Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[94](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#94)                op: op!("="),
[95](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#95)                left: AssignTarget::Simple(l),
[96](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#96)                right: r,
[97](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#97)                ..
[98](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#98)            }) if match &*l {
[99](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#99)                SimpleAssignTarget::Ident(l) => match &**r {
[100](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#100)                    Expr::Ident(r) => l.sym == r.sym && l.ctxt == r.ctxt,
[101](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#101)                    _ => false,
[102](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#102)                },
[103](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#103)                _ => false,
[104](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#104)            } =>
[105](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#105)            {
[106](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#106)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[107](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#107)                    debug!("Dropping assignment to the same variable");
[108](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#108)                }
[109](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#109)                *e = r.take().ident().unwrap().into();
[110](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#110)            }
[111](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#111)
[112](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#112)            Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[113](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#113)                op: op!("="),
[114](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#114)                left: AssignTarget::Pat(left),
[115](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#115)                right,
[116](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#116)                ..
[117](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#117)            }) if match &*left {
[118](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#118)                AssignTargetPat::Array(arr) => {
[119](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#119)                    arr.elems.is_empty() || arr.elems.iter().all(|v| v.is_none())
[120](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#120)                }
[121](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#121)                _ => false,
[122](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#122)            } =>
[123](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#123)            {
[124](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#124)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[125](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#125)                    debug!("Dropping assignment to an empty array pattern");
[126](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#126)                }
[127](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#127)                *e = *right.take();
[128](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#128)            }
[129](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#129)
[130](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#130)            Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[131](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#131)                op: op!("="),
[132](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#132)                left: AssignTarget::Pat(left),
[133](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#133)                right,
[134](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#134)                ..
[135](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#135)            }) if match &*left {
[136](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#136)                AssignTargetPat::Object(obj) => obj.props.is_empty(),
[137](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#137)                _ => false,
[138](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#138)            } =>
[139](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#139)            {
[140](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#140)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[141](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#141)                    debug!("Dropping assignment to an empty object pattern");
[142](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#142)                }
[143](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#143)                *e = *right.take();
[144](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#144)            }
[145](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#145)
[146](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#146)            Expr::Cond(cond)
[147](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#147)                if !cond.test.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx)
[148](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#148)                    && (cond.cons.is_undefined(self.expr_ctx)
[149](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#149)                        || matches!(*cond.cons, Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[150](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#150)                                op: op!("void"),
[151](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#151)                                ref arg,
[152](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#152)                                ..
[153](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#153)                            }) if !arg.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx)))
[154](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#154)                    && (cond.alt.is_undefined(self.expr_ctx)
[155](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#155)                        || matches!(*cond.alt, Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[156](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#156)                                op: op!("void"),
[157](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#157)                                ref arg,
[158](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#158)                                ..
[159](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#159)                            }) if !arg.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx))) =>
[160](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#160)            {
[161](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#161)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[162](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#162)                    debug!("Dropping side-effect-free expressions");
[163](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#163)                }
[164](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#164)                *e = *cond.cons.take();
[165](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#165)            }
[166](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#166)
[167](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#167)            Expr::Bin(be) => match (be.left.is_invalid(), be.right.is_invalid()) {
[168](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#168)                (true, true) => {
[169](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#169)                    *e = Expr::dummy();
[170](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#170)                }
[171](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#171)                (true, false) => {
[172](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#172)                    *e = *be.right.take();
[173](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#173)                }
[174](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#174)                (false, true) => {
[175](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#175)                    *e = *be.left.take();
[176](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#176)                }
[177](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#177)                _ => {}
[178](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#178)            },
[179](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#179)
[180](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#180)            _ => {}
[181](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#181)        }
[182](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#182)    }
[183](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#183)
[184](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#184)    fn visit_mut_expr_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ExprOrSpread>) {
[185](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#185)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count() * 8, n, |v, n| {
[186](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#186)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
[187](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#187)        })

[191](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#191)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count() * 8, n, |v, n| {

[196](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#196)    fn visit_mut_for_stmt(&mut self, s: &mut ForStmt) {
[197](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#197)        s.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[198](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#198)
[199](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#199)        s.init = s.init.take().and_then(|e| match e {
[200](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#200)            VarDeclOrExpr::Expr(e) => {
[201](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#201)                ignore_result(e, true, self.expr_ctx).map(VarDeclOrExpr::from)
[202](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#202)            }
[203](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#203)            _ => Some(e),
[204](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#204)        });
[205](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#205)
[206](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#206)        s.update = s
[207](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#207)            .update
[208](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#208)            .take()
[209](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#209)            .and_then(|e| ignore_result(e, true, self.expr_ctx));
[210](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#210)
[211](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#211)        s.test = s.test.take().and_then(|e| {
[212](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#212)            let span = e.span();
[213](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#213)            if let Known(value) = e.as_pure_bool(self.expr_ctx) {
[214](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#214)                return if value {
[215](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#215)                    None
[216](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#216)                } else {
[217](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#217)                    Some(Lit::Bool(Bool { span, value: false }).into())
[218](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#218)                };
[219](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#219)            }
[220](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#220)
[221](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#221)            Some(e)
[222](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#222)        });
[223](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#223)    }
[224](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#224)
[225](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#225)    fn visit_mut_module_items(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ModuleItem>) {
[226](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#226)        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[227](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#227)            debug!("Removing dead branches");
[228](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#228)        }
[229](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#229)        self.fold_stmt_like(n);
[230](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#230)    }

[232](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#232)    fn visit_mut_object_pat(&mut self, p: &mut ObjectPat) {
[233](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#233)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[234](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#234)
[235](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#235)        // Don't remove if there exists a rest pattern
[236](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#236)        if p.props.iter().any(|p| matches!(p, ObjectPatProp::Rest(..))) {
[237](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#237)            return;
[238](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#238)        }
[239](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#239)
[240](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#240)        fn is_computed(k: &PropName) -> bool {
[241](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#241)            matches!(k, PropName::Computed(..))
[242](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#242)        }
[243](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#243)
[244](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#244)        p.props.retain(|p| match p {
[245](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#245)            ObjectPatProp::KeyValue(KeyValuePatProp { key, value, .. })
[246](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#246)                if match &**value {
[247](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#247)                    Pat::Object(p) => !is_computed(key) && p.props.is_empty(),
[248](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#248)                    _ => false,
[249](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#249)                } =>
[250](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#250)            {
[251](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#251)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[252](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#252)                    debug!(
[253](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#253)                        "Dropping key-value pattern property because it's an empty object pattern"
[254](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#254)                    );
[255](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#255)                }
[256](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#256)                false
[257](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#257)            }
[258](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#258)
[259](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#259)            ObjectPatProp::KeyValue(KeyValuePatProp { key, value, .. })
[260](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#260)                if match &**value {
[261](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#261)                    Pat::Array(p) => !is_computed(key) && p.elems.is_empty(),
[262](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#262)                    _ => false,
[263](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#263)                } =>
[264](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#264)            {
[265](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#265)                if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[266](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#266)                    debug!(
[267](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#267)                        "Dropping key-value pattern property because it's an empty array pattern"
[268](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#268)                    );
[269](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#269)                }
[270](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#270)                false
[271](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#271)            }
[272](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#272)            _ => true,
[273](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#273)        });
[274](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#274)    }
[275](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#275)
[276](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#276)    fn visit_mut_object_pat_prop(&mut self, p: &mut ObjectPatProp) {
[277](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#277)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[278](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#278)
[279](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#279)        match p {
[280](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#280)            ObjectPatProp::Assign(AssignPatProp {
[281](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#281)                span,
[282](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#282)                key,
[283](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#283)                value: Some(expr),
[284](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#284)            }) if expr.is_undefined(self.expr_ctx)
[285](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#285)                || match **expr {
[286](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#286)                    Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[287](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#287)                        op: op!("void"),
[288](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#288)                        ref arg,
[289](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#289)                        ..
[290](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#290)                    }) => is_literal(&**arg),
[291](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#291)                    _ => false,
[292](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#292)                } =>
[293](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#293)            {
[294](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#294)                *p = ObjectPatProp::Assign(AssignPatProp {
[295](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#295)                    span: *span,
[296](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#296)                    key: key.take(),
[297](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#297)                    value: None,
[298](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#298)                });
[299](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#299)            }
[300](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#300)
[301](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#301)            _ => {}
[302](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#302)        }
[303](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#303)    }

[305](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#305)    fn visit_mut_opt_var_decl_or_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Option<VarDeclOrExpr>) {
[306](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#306)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[307](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#307)
[308](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#308)        if let Some(VarDeclOrExpr::Expr(e)) = n {

[316](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#316)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count() * 8, n, |v, n| {

[320](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#320)
[321](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#321)    fn visit_mut_pat(&mut self, p: &mut Pat) {
[322](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#322)        p.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[323](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#323)
[324](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#324)        match p {
[325](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#325)            Pat::Assign(assign)
[326](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#326)                if assign.right.is_undefined(self.expr_ctx)
[327](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#327)                    || match *assign.right {
[328](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#328)                        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[329](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#329)                            op: op!("void"),
[330](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#330)                            ref arg,
[331](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#331)                            ..
[332](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#332)                        }) => is_literal(&**arg),
[333](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#333)                        _ => false,
[334](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#334)                    } =>
[335](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#335)            {
[336](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#336)                *p = *assign.left.take();
[337](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#337)            }
[338](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#338)
[339](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#339)            _ => {}
[340](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#340)        }
[341](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#341)    }
[342](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#342)
[343](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#343)    fn visit_mut_prop_or_spreads(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<PropOrSpread>) {
[344](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#344)        self.maybe_par(cpu_count() * 8, n, |v, n| {
[345](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#345)            n.visit_mut_with(v);
