[349](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#349)    fn visit_mut_seq_expr(&mut self, e: &mut SeqExpr) {
[350](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#350)        e.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[351](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#351)        if e.exprs.is_empty() {
[352](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#352)            return;
[353](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#353)        }
[354](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#354)
[355](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#355)        let last = e.exprs.pop().unwrap();
[356](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#356)
[357](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#357)        let should_preserved_this = last.directness_matters();
[358](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#358)
[359](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#359)        let mut exprs = if should_preserved_this {
[360](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#360)            e.exprs
[361](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#361)                .take()
[362](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#362)                .into_iter()
[363](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#363)                .enumerate()
[364](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#364)                .filter_map(|(idx, e)| {
[365](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#365)                    if idx == 0 {
[366](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#366)                        return Some(e);
[367](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#367)                    }
[368](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#368)
[369](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#369)                    ignore_result(e, true, self.expr_ctx)
[370](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#370)                })
[371](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#371)                .collect()
[372](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#372)        } else {
[373](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#373)            e.exprs
[374](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#374)                .take()
[375](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#375)                .move_flat_map(|e| ignore_result(e, false, self.expr_ctx))
[376](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#376)        };
[377](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#377)
[378](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#378)        exprs.push(last);
[379](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#379)
[380](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#380)        e.exprs = exprs;
[381](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#381)    }
[382](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#382)
[383](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#383)    fn visit_mut_stmt(&mut self, stmt: &mut Stmt) {
[384](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#384)        stmt.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[385](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#385)
[386](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#386)        stmt.map_with_mut(|stmt| {
[387](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#387)            match stmt {
[388](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#388)                Stmt::If(IfStmt {
[389](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#389)                    span,
[390](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#390)                    test,
[391](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#391)                    cons,
[392](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#392)                    alt,
[393](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#393)                }) => {
[394](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#394)                    if let Stmt::If(IfStmt { alt: Some(..), .. }) = *cons {
[395](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#395)                        return IfStmt {
[396](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#396)                            test,
[397](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#397)                            cons: Box::new(
[398](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#398)                                BlockStmt {
[399](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#399)                                    stmts: vec![*cons],
[400](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#400)                                    ..Default::default()
[401](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#401)                                }
[402](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#402)                                .into(),
[403](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#403)                            ),
[404](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#404)                            alt,
[405](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#405)                            span,
[406](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#406)                        }
[407](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#407)                        .into();
[408](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#408)                    }
[409](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#409)
[410](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#410)                    let mut stmts = Vec::new();
[411](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#411)                    if let (p, Known(v)) = test.cast_to_bool(self.expr_ctx) {
[412](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#412)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[413](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#413)                            trace!("The condition for if statement is always {}", v);
[414](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#414)                        }
[415](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#415)
[416](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#416)                        // Preserve effect of the test
[417](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#417)                        if !p.is_pure() {
[418](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#418)                            if let Some(expr) = ignore_result(test, true, self.expr_ctx) {
[419](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#419)                                stmts.push(ExprStmt { span, expr }.into())
[420](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#420)                            }
[421](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#421)                        }
[422](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#422)
[423](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#423)                        if v {
[424](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#424)                            // Preserve variables
[425](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#425)                            if let Some(var) = alt.and_then(|alt| alt.extract_var_ids_as_var()) {
[426](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#426)                                stmts.push(var.into())
[427](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#427)                            }
[428](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#428)                            stmts.push(*cons);
[429](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#429)                        } else {
[430](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#430)                            if let Some(var) = cons.extract_var_ids_as_var() {
[431](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#431)                                stmts.push(var.into())
[432](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#432)                            }
[433](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#433)
[434](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#434)                            if let Some(alt) = alt {
[435](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#435)                                stmts.push(*alt)
[436](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#436)                            }
[437](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#437)                        }
[438](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#438)
[439](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#439)                        if stmts.is_empty() {
[440](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#440)                            return EmptyStmt { span }.into();
[441](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#441)                        }
[442](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#442)
[443](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#443)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[444](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#444)                            debug!("Optimized an if statement with known condition");
[445](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#445)                        }
[446](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#446)
[447](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#447)                        self.changed = true;
[448](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#448)
[449](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#449)                        let mut block: Stmt = BlockStmt {
[450](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#450)                            span,
[451](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#451)                            stmts,
[452](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#452)                            ..Default::default()
[453](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#453)                        }
[454](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#454)                        .into();
[455](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#455)                        block.visit_mut_with(self);
[456](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#456)                        return block;
[457](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#457)                    }
[458](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#458)
[459](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#459)                    let alt = match &alt {
[460](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#460)                        Some(stmt) if stmt.is_empty() => None,
[461](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#461)                        _ => alt,
[462](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#462)                    };
[463](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#463)                    if alt.is_none() {
[464](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#464)                        if let Stmt::Empty(..) = *cons {
[465](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#465)                            self.changed = true;
[466](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#466)
[467](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#467)                            return if let Some(expr) = ignore_result(test, true, self.expr_ctx) {
[468](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#468)                                ExprStmt { span, expr }.into()
[469](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#469)                            } else {
[470](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#470)                                EmptyStmt { span }.into()
[471](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#471)                            };
[472](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#472)                        }
[473](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#473)                    }
[474](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#474)
[475](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#475)                    IfStmt {
[476](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#476)                        span,
[477](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#477)                        test,
[478](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#478)                        cons,
[479](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#479)                        alt,
[480](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#480)                    }
[481](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#481)                    .into()
[482](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#482)                }
[483](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#483)
[484](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#484)                Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(v)) if v.decls.is_empty() => {
[485](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#485)                    if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[486](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#486)                        debug!("Dropping an empty var declaration");
[487](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#487)                    }
[488](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#488)                    EmptyStmt { span: v.span }.into()
[489](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#489)                }
[490](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#490)
[491](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#491)                Stmt::Labeled(LabeledStmt {
[492](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#492)                    label, span, body, ..
[493](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#493)                }) if body.is_empty() => {
[494](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#494)                    debug!("Dropping an empty label statement: `{}`", label);
[495](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#495)                    EmptyStmt { span }.into()
[496](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#496)                }
[497](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#497)
[498](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#498)                Stmt::Labeled(LabeledStmt {
[499](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#499)                    span,
[500](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#500)                    body,
[501](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#501)                    ref label,
[502](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#502)                    ..
[503](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#503)                }) if match &*body {
[504](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#504)                    Stmt::Break(BreakStmt { label: Some(b), .. }) => label.sym == b.sym,
[505](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#505)                    _ => false,
[506](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#506)                } =>
[507](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#507)                {
[508](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#508)                    debug!("Dropping a label statement with instant break: `{}`", label);
[509](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#509)                    EmptyStmt { span }.into()
[510](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#510)                }
[511](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#511)
[512](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#512)                // `1;` -> `;`
[513](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#513)                Stmt::Expr(ExprStmt { span, expr, .. }) => {
[514](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#514)                    // Directives
[515](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#515)                    if let Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..)) = &*expr {
[516](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#516)                        return ExprStmt { span, expr }.into();
[517](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#517)                    }
[518](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#518)
[519](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#519)                    match ignore_result(expr, false, self.expr_ctx) {
[520](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#520)                        Some(e) => ExprStmt { span, expr: e }.into(),
[521](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#521)                        None => EmptyStmt { span: DUMMY_SP }.into(),
[522](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#522)                    }
[523](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#523)                }
[524](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#524)
[525](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#525)                Stmt::Block(BlockStmt { span, stmts, ctxt }) => {
[526](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#526)                    if stmts.is_empty() {
[527](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#527)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[528](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#528)                            debug!("Drooping an empty block statement");
[529](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#529)                        }
[530](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#530)
[531](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#531)                        EmptyStmt { span }.into()
[532](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#532)                    } else if stmts.len() == 1
[533](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#533)                        && !is_block_scoped_stuff(&stmts[0])
[534](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#534)                        && stmt_depth(&stmts[0]) <= 1
[535](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#535)                    {
[536](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#536)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[537](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#537)                            debug!("Optimizing a block statement with a single statement");
[538](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#538)                        }
[539](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#539)
[540](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#540)                        let mut v = stmts.into_iter().next().unwrap();
[541](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#541)                        v.visit_mut_with(self);
[542](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#542)                        v
[543](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#543)                    } else {
[544](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#544)                        BlockStmt { span, stmts, ctxt }.into()
[545](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#545)                    }
[546](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#546)                }
[547](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#547)                Stmt::Try(s) => {
[548](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#548)                    let TryStmt {
[549](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#549)                        span,
[550](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#550)                        block,
[551](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#551)                        handler,
[552](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#552)                        finalizer,
[553](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#553)                    } = *s;
[554](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#554)
[555](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#555)                    // Only leave the finally block if try block is empty
[556](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#556)                    if block.is_empty() {
[557](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#557)                        let var = handler.and_then(|h| Stmt::from(h.body).extract_var_ids_as_var());
[558](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#558)
[559](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#559)                        return if let Some(mut finalizer) = finalizer {
[560](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#560)                            if let Some(var) = var.map(Box::new).map(Decl::from).map(Stmt::from) {
[561](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#561)                                prepend_stmt(&mut finalizer.stmts, var);
[562](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#562)                            }
[563](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#563)                            finalizer.into()
[564](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#564)                        } else {
[565](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#565)                            var.map(Box::new)
[566](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#566)                                .map(Decl::from)
[567](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#567)                                .map(Stmt::from)
[568](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#568)                                .unwrap_or_else(|| EmptyStmt { span }.into())
[569](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#569)                        };
[570](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#570)                    }
[571](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#571)
[572](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#572)                    // If catch block is not specified and finally block is empty, fold it to simple
[573](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#573)                    // block.
[574](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#574)                    if handler.is_none() && finalizer.is_empty() {
[575](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#575)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[576](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#576)                            debug!("Converting a try statement to a block statement");
[577](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#577)                        }
[578](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#578)
[579](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#579)                        return block.into();
[580](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#580)                    }
[581](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#581)
[582](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#582)                    TryStmt {
[583](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#583)                        span,
[584](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#584)                        block,
[585](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#585)                        handler,
[586](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#586)                        finalizer,
[587](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#587)                    }
[588](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#588)                    .into()
[589](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#589)                }
[590](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#590)
[591](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#591)                Stmt::Switch(mut s) => {
[592](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#592)                    if s.cases
[593](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#593)                        .iter()
[594](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#594)                        .any(|case| matches!(case.test.as_deref(), Some(Expr::Update(..))))
[595](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#595)                    {
[596](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#596)                        return s.into();
[597](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#597)                    }
[598](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#598)                    if let Expr::Update(..) = &*s.discriminant {
[599](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#599)                        if s.cases.len() != 1 {
[600](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#600)                            return s.into();
[601](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#601)                        }
[602](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#602)                    }
[603](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#603)
[604](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#604)                    let remove_break = |stmts: Vec<Stmt>| {
[605](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#605)                        debug_assert!(
[606](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#606)                            !has_conditional_stopper(&stmts) || has_unconditional_stopper(&stmts)
[607](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#607)                        );
[608](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#608)
[609](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#609)                        let mut done = false;
[610](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#610)                        stmts.move_flat_map(|s| {
[611](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#611)                            if done {
[612](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#612)                                match s {
[613](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#613)                                    Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(var))
[614](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#614)                                        if matches!(
[615](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#615)                                            &*var,
[616](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#616)                                            VarDecl {
[617](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#617)                                                kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[618](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#618)                                                ..
[619](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#619)                                            }
[620](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#620)                                        ) =>
[621](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#621)                                    {
[622](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#622)                                        return Some(
[623](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#623)                                            VarDecl {
[624](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#624)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[625](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#625)                                                kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[626](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#626)                                                decls: var.decls.move_map(|decl| VarDeclarator {
[627](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#627)                                                    init: None,
[628](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#628)                                                    ..decl
[629](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#629)                                                }),
[630](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#630)                                                ..Default::default()
[631](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#631)                                            }
[632](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#632)                                            .into(),
[633](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#633)                                        );
[634](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#634)                                    }
[635](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#635)                                    _ => (),
[636](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#636)                                }
[637](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#637)
[638](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#638)                                return None;
[639](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#639)                            }
[640](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#640)                            match s {
[641](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#641)                                Stmt::Break(BreakStmt { label: None, .. }) => {
[642](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#642)                                    done = true;
[643](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#643)                                    None
[644](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#644)                                }
[645](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#645)                                Stmt::Return(..) | Stmt::Throw(..) => {
[646](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#646)                                    done = true;
[647](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#647)                                    Some(s)
[648](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#648)                                }
[649](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#649)                                _ => Some(s),
[650](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#650)                            }
[651](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#651)                        })
[652](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#652)                    };
[653](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#653)
[654](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#654)                    let is_matching_literal = match *s.discriminant {
[655](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#655)                        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..))
[656](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#656)                        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..))
[657](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#657)                        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..)) => true,
[658](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#658)                        ref e if e.is_nan() || e.is_global_ref_to(self.expr_ctx, "undefined") => {
[659](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#659)                            true
[660](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#660)                        }
[661](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#661)                        _ => false,
[662](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#662)                    };
[663](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#663)
[664](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#664)                    // Remove empty switch
[665](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#665)                    if s.cases.is_empty() {
[666](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#666)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[667](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#667)                            debug!("Removing an empty switch statement");
[668](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#668)                        }
[669](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#669)                        return match ignore_result(s.discriminant, true, self.expr_ctx) {
[670](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#670)                            Some(expr) => ExprStmt { span: s.span, expr }.into(),
[671](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#671)                            None => EmptyStmt { span: s.span }.into(),
[672](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#672)                        };
[673](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#673)                    }
[674](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#674)
[675](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#675)                    // Handle a switch statement with only default.
[676](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#676)                    if s.cases.len() == 1
[677](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#677)                        && s.cases[0].test.is_none()
[678](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#678)                        && !has_conditional_stopper(&s.cases[0].cons)
[679](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#679)                    {
[680](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#680)                        if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[681](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#681)                            debug!("Switch -> Block as default is the only case");
[682](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#682)                        }
[683](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#683)
[684](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#684)                        let mut stmts = remove_break(s.cases.remove(0).cons);
[685](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#685)                        if let Some(expr) = ignore_result(s.discriminant, true, self.expr_ctx) {
[686](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#686)                            prepend_stmt(&mut stmts, expr.into_stmt());
[687](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#687)                        }
[688](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#688)
[689](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#689)                        let mut block: Stmt = BlockStmt {
[690](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#690)                            span: s.span,
[691](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#691)                            stmts,
[692](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#692)                            ..Default::default()
[693](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#693)                        }
[694](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#694)                        .into();
[695](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#695)                        block.visit_mut_with(self);
[696](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#696)                        return block;
[697](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#697)                    }
[698](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#698)
[699](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#699)                    let mut non_constant_case_idx = None;
[700](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#700)                    let selected = {
[701](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#701)                        let mut i = 0;
[702](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#702)                        s.cases.iter().position(|case| {
[703](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#703)                            if non_constant_case_idx.is_some() {
[704](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#704)                                i += 1;
[705](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#705)                                return false;
[706](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#706)                            }
[707](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#707)
[708](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#708)                            if let Some(ref test) = case.test {
[709](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#709)                                let v = match (&**test, &*s.discriminant) {
[710](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#710)                                    (
[711](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#711)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str {
[712](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#712)                                            value: ref test, ..
[713](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#713)                                        })),
[714](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#714)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str { value: ref d, .. })),
[715](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#715)                                    ) => *test == *d,
[716](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#716)                                    (
[717](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#717)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value: test, .. })),
[718](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#718)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(Number { value: d, .. })),
[719](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#719)                                    ) => (test - d).abs() < 1e-10,
[720](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#720)                                    (
[721](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#721)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(Bool { value: test, .. })),
[722](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#722)                                        &Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(Bool { value: d, .. })),
[723](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#723)                                    ) => test == d,
[724](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#724)                                    (&Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)), &Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..))) => true,
[725](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#725)
[726](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#726)                                    _ => {
[727](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#727)                                        if !test.is_nan()
[728](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#728)                                            && !test.is_global_ref_to(self.expr_ctx, "undefined")
[729](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#729)                                        {
[730](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#730)                                            non_constant_case_idx = Some(i);
[731](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#731)                                        }
[732](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#732)
[733](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#733)                                        false
[734](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#734)                                    }
[735](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#735)                                };
[736](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#736)
[737](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#737)                                i += 1;
[738](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#738)                                return v;
[739](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#739)                            }
[740](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#740)
[741](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#741)                            i += 1;
[742](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#742)                            false
[743](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#743)                        })
[744](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#744)                    };
[745](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#745)
[746](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#746)                    let are_all_tests_known = s
[747](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#747)                        .cases
[748](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#748)                        .iter()
[749](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#749)                        .map(|case| case.test.as_deref())
[750](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#750)                        .all(|s| matches!(s, Some(Expr::Lit(..)) | None));
[751](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#751)
[752](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#752)                    let mut var_ids = Vec::new();
[753](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#753)                    if let Some(i) = selected {
[754](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#754)                        if !has_conditional_stopper(&s.cases[i].cons) {
[755](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#755)                            let mut exprs = Vec::new();
[756](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#756)                            exprs.extend(ignore_result(s.discriminant, true, self.expr_ctx));
[757](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#757)
[758](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#758)                            let mut stmts = s.cases[i].cons.take();
[759](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#759)                            let mut cases = s.cases.drain((i + 1)..);
[760](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#760)
[761](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#761)                            for case in cases.by_ref() {
[762](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#762)                                let should_stop = has_unconditional_stopper(&case.cons);
[763](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#763)                                stmts.extend(case.cons);
[764](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#764)                                //
[765](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#765)                                if should_stop {
[766](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#766)                                    break;
[767](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#767)                                }
[768](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#768)                            }
[769](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#769)
[770](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#770)                            let mut stmts = remove_break(stmts);
[771](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#771)
[772](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#772)                            let decls = cases
[773](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#773)                                .flat_map(|case| {

[775](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#775)                                        case.test
[776](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#776)                                            .and_then(|e| ignore_result(e, true, self.expr_ctx)),
[777](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#777)                                    );

[779](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#779)                                })

[782](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#782)                                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[783](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#783)                                    name: i.into(),
[784](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#784)                                    init: None,
[785](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#785)                                    definite: false,
[786](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#786)                                })
[787](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#787)                                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[788](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#788)
[789](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#789)                            if !decls.is_empty() {
[790](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#790)                                prepend_stmt(
[791](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#791)                                    &mut stmts,
[792](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#792)                                    VarDecl {
[793](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#793)                                        span: DUMMY_SP,
[794](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#794)                                        kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[795](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#795)                                        decls,
[796](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#796)                                        declare: false,
[797](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#797)                                        ..Default::default()
[798](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#798)                                    }
[799](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#799)                                    .into(),
[800](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#800)                                );
[801](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#801)                            }
[802](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#802)
[803](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#803)                            if !exprs.is_empty() {
[804](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#804)                                prepend_stmt(
[805](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#805)                                    &mut stmts,
[806](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#806)                                    ExprStmt {
[807](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#807)                                        span: DUMMY_SP,
[808](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#808)                                        expr: if exprs.len() == 1 {
[809](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#809)                                            exprs.remove(0)
[810](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#810)                                        } else {
[811](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#811)                                            SeqExpr {
[812](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#812)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[813](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#813)                                                exprs,
[814](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#814)                                            }
[815](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#815)                                            .into()
[816](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#816)                                        },
[817](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#817)                                    }
[818](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#818)                                    .into(),
[819](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#819)                                );
[820](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#820)                            }
[821](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#821)
[822](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#822)                            if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[823](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#823)                                debug!("Switch -> Block as we know discriminant");
[824](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#824)                            }
[825](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#825)                            let mut block: Stmt = BlockStmt {
[826](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#826)                                span: s.span,
[827](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#827)                                stmts,
[828](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#828)                                ..Default::default()
[829](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#829)                            }
[830](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#830)                            .into();
[831](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#831)                            block.visit_mut_with(self);
[832](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#832)                            return block;
[833](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#833)                        }
[834](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#834)                    } else if are_all_tests_known {
[835](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#835)                        let mut vars = Vec::new();
[836](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#836)
[837](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#837)                        if let Expr::Lit(..) = *s.discriminant {
[838](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#838)                            let idx = s.cases.iter().position(|v| v.test.is_none());
[839](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#839)
[840](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#840)                            if let Some(i) = idx {
[841](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#841)                                for case in &s.cases[..i] {
[842](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#842)                                    for cons in &case.cons {
[843](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#843)                                        vars.extend(cons.extract_var_ids().into_iter().map(
[844](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#844)                                            |name| VarDeclarator {
[845](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#845)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[846](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#846)                                                name: name.into(),
[847](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#847)                                                init: None,
[848](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#848)                                                definite: Default::default(),
[849](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#849)                                            },
[850](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#850)                                        ));
[851](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#851)                                    }
[852](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#852)                                }
[853](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#853)
[854](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#854)                                if !has_conditional_stopper(&s.cases[i].cons) {
[855](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#855)                                    let stmts = s.cases.remove(i).cons;
[856](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#856)                                    let mut stmts = remove_break(stmts);
[857](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#857)
[858](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#858)                                    if !vars.is_empty() {
[859](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#859)                                        prepend_stmt(
[860](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#860)                                            &mut stmts,
[861](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#861)                                            VarDecl {
[862](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#862)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[863](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#863)                                                kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[864](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#864)                                                declare: Default::default(),
[865](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#865)                                                decls: take(&mut vars),
[866](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#866)                                                ..Default::default()
[867](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#867)                                            }
[868](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#868)                                            .into(),
[869](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#869)                                        )
[870](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#870)                                    }
[871](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#871)
[872](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#872)                                    let mut block: Stmt = BlockStmt {
[873](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#873)                                        span: s.span,
[874](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#874)                                        stmts,
[875](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#875)                                        ..Default::default()
[876](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#876)                                    }
[877](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#877)                                    .into();
[878](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#878)
[879](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#879)                                    block.visit_mut_with(self);
[880](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#880)
[881](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#881)                                    if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[882](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#882)                                        debug!("Switch -> Block as the discriminant is a literal");
[883](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#883)                                    }
[884](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#884)                                    return block;
[885](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#885)                                }
[886](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#886)                            }
[887](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#887)                        }
[888](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#888)                    }
[889](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#889)
[890](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#890)                    if is_matching_literal {
[891](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#891)                        let mut idx = 0usize;
[892](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#892)                        let mut breaked = false;
[893](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#893)                        // Remove unmatchable cases.
[894](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#894)                        s.cases = s.cases.move_flat_map(|case| {
[895](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#895)                            if non_constant_case_idx.is_some()
[896](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#896)                                && idx >= non_constant_case_idx.unwrap()
[897](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#897)                            {
[898](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#898)                                idx += 1;
[899](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#899)                                return Some(case);
[900](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#900)                            }
[901](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#901)
[902](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#902)                            // Detect unconditional break;
[903](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#903)                            if selected.is_some() && selected <= Some(idx) {
[904](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#904)                                // Done.
[905](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#905)                                if breaked {
[906](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#906)                                    idx += 1;
[907](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#907)                                    if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[908](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#908)                                        debug!("Dropping case because it is unreachable");
[909](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#909)                                    }
[910](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#910)                                    return None;
[911](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#911)                                }
[912](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#912)
[913](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#913)                                if !breaked {
[914](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#914)                                    // has unconditional break
[915](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#915)                                    breaked |= has_unconditional_stopper(&case.cons);
[916](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#916)                                }
[917](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#917)
[918](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#918)                                idx += 1;
[919](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#919)                                return Some(case);
[920](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#920)                            }
[921](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#921)
[922](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#922)                            let res = match case.test {
[923](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#923)                                Some(e)
[924](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#924)                                    if matches!(
[925](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#925)                                        &*e,
[926](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#926)                                        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[927](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#927)                                            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..))
[928](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#928)                                            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..))
[929](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#929)                                    ) =>
[930](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#930)                                {
[931](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#931)                                    case.cons
[932](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#932)                                        .into_iter()
[933](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#933)                                        .for_each(|stmt| var_ids.extend(stmt.extract_var_ids()));
[934](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#934)
[935](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#935)                                    if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[936](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#936)                                        debug!(
[937](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#937)                                            "Dropping case because it is unreachable (literal \
[938](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#938)                                             test)"
[939](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#939)                                        );
[940](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#940)                                    }
[941](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#941)                                    None
[942](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#942)                                }
[943](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#943)                                _ => Some(case),
[944](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#944)                            };
[945](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#945)                            idx += 1;
[946](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#946)                            res
[947](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#947)                        });
[948](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#948)                    }
[949](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#949)
[950](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#950)                    let is_default_last =
[951](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#951)                        matches!(s.cases.last(), Some(SwitchCase { test: None, .. }));
[952](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#952)
[953](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#953)                    {
[954](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#954)                        // True if all cases except default is empty.
[955](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#955)                        let is_all_case_empty = s
[956](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#956)                            .cases
[957](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#957)                            .iter()
[958](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#958)                            .all(|case| case.test.is_none() || case.cons.is_empty());
[959](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#959)
[960](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#960)                        let is_all_case_side_effect_free = s.cases.iter().all(|case| {
[961](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#961)                            case.test
[962](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#962)                                .as_ref()
[963](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#963)                                .map(|e| e.is_ident() || !e.may_have_side_effects(self.expr_ctx))
[964](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#964)                                .unwrap_or(true)
[965](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#965)                        });
[966](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#966)
[967](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#967)                        if is_default_last
[968](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#968)                            && is_all_case_empty
[969](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#969)                            && is_all_case_side_effect_free
[970](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#970)                            && !has_conditional_stopper(&s.cases.last().unwrap().cons)
[971](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#971)                        {
[972](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#972)                            let mut exprs = Vec::new();
[973](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#973)                            exprs.extend(ignore_result(s.discriminant, true, self.expr_ctx));
[974](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#974)
[975](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#975)                            exprs.extend(
[976](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#976)                                s.cases
[977](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#977)                                    .iter_mut()
[978](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#978)                                    .filter_map(|case| case.test.take())
[979](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#979)                                    .filter_map(|e| ignore_result(e, true, self.expr_ctx)),
[980](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#980)                            );
[981](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#981)
[982](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#982)                            let stmts = s.cases.pop().unwrap().cons;
[983](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#983)                            let mut stmts = remove_break(stmts);
[984](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#984)
[985](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#985)                            if !exprs.is_empty() {
[986](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#986)                                prepend_stmt(
[987](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#987)                                    &mut stmts,
[988](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#988)                                    ExprStmt {
[989](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#989)                                        span: DUMMY_SP,
[990](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#990)                                        expr: if exprs.len() == 1 {
[991](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#991)                                            exprs.remove(0)
[992](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#992)                                        } else {
[993](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#993)                                            SeqExpr {
[994](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#994)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[995](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#995)                                                exprs,
[996](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#996)                                            }
[997](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#997)                                            .into()
[998](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#998)                                        },
[999](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#999)                                    }
[1000](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1000)                                    .into(),
[1001](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1001)                                );
[1002](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1002)                            }
[1003](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1003)
[1004](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1004)                            if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[1005](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1005)                                debug!("Stmt -> Block as all cases are empty");
[1006](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1006)                            }
[1007](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1007)                            let mut block: Stmt = BlockStmt {
[1008](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1008)                                span: s.span,
[1009](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1009)                                stmts,
[1010](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1010)                                ..Default::default()
[1011](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1011)                            }
[1012](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1012)                            .into();
[1013](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1013)                            block.visit_mut_with(self);
[1014](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1014)                            return block;
[1015](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1015)                        }
[1016](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1016)                    }
[1017](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1017)
[1018](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1018)                    if is_matching_literal
[1019](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1019)                        && s.cases.iter().all(|case| match &case.test {
[1020](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1020)                            Some(e)
[1021](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1021)                                if matches!(
[1022](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1022)                                    &**e,
[1023](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1023)                                    Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..))
[1024](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1024)                                        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..))
[1025](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1025)                                        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[1026](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1026)                                ) =>
[1027](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1027)                            {
[1028](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1028)                                true
[1029](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1029)                            }
[1030](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1030)                            _ => false,
[1031](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1031)                        })
[1032](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1032)                    {
[1033](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1033)                        // No case can be matched.
[1034](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1034)                        if s.cases
[1035](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1035)                            .iter()
[1036](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1036)                            .all(|case| !has_conditional_stopper(&case.cons))
[1037](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1037)                        {
[1038](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1038)                            if cfg!(feature = "debug") {
[1039](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1039)                                debug!("Removing swtich because all cases are unreachable");
[1040](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1040)                            }
[1041](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#1041)
